$WebRoot  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web'
if (-not (Test-Path $WebRoot)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\m1-08-global-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$AppRel     = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\App.tsx'
$LayoutRel  = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\components\AppLayout.tsx'
$ApiOldRel  = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\api\phase8Assistant.ts'
$ApiNewRel  = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\api\assistantApi.ts'
$CfgPageRel = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\AssistantConfigurationPage.tsx'
$RunPageRel = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\AssistantRuntimePage.tsx'
$SugPageRel = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\SuggestionRecommendationPage.tsx'
$TestRel    = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\phase8AssistantView.test.ts'
$GateRel    = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\test\architecture\noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath.test.ts'

$ToBackup = @($AppRel, $LayoutRel, $ApiOldRel, $CfgPageRel, $RunPageRel, $SugPageRel, $TestRel)
$Created  = @($ApiNewRel, $GateRel)

foreach ($rel in $ToBackup) {
    $src = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
    if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { Write-Host ('FATAL: missing ' + $rel) -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
    Copy-Item $src (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    Write-Host ('  backup: ' + $rel) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $ToBackup) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak (Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel) -Force }
    }
    foreach ($rel in $Created) {
        $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
        if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Force }
    }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Write-NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    $n = ($Content -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $n, $Utf8NoBom)
}

function Replace-First {
    param([string]$Text, [string]$Old, [string]$New, [string]$Label)
    $i = $Text.IndexOf($Old)
    if ($i -lt 0) { throw ("Replace-First: not found [" + $Old + "] in " + $Label) }
    return $Text.Remove($i, $Old.Length).Insert($i, $New)
}

function Replace-Last {
    param([string]$Text, [string]$Old, [string]$New, [string]$Label)
    $i = $Text.LastIndexOf($Old)
    if ($i -lt 0) { throw ("Replace-Last: not found [" + $Old + "] in " + $Label) }
    return $Text.Remove($i, $Old.Length).Insert($i, $New)
}

Write-Host '=== M1-08 GLOBAL: phase-token eradication ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. api rename + symbol renames + importers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try {
    $apiOldPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $ApiOldRel
    $apiNewPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $ApiNewRel
    if (Test-Path $apiNewPath) { throw 'assistantApi.ts already exists - clean it or investigate first.' }

    $api = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($apiOldPath)
    $api = $api.Replace('export const phase8AssistantApi = {', 'export const assistantApi = {')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfigSaveResponse', 'AssistantConfigSaveResponse')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfiguration', 'AssistantConfiguration')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantCitation', 'AssistantCitation')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantAnswer', 'AssistantAnswer')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRecommendation', 'SuggestionRecommendation')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRequest', 'SuggestionRequest')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8SuggestionResponse', 'SuggestionResponse')

    $hdr = "// ============================================================`r`n" +
           "// FILE: Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/api/assistantApi.ts`r`n" +
           "// M1-08: renamed from phase8Assistant.ts (Naming Golden Rule).`r`n" +
           "// Backend endpoint paths (/api/phase8/...) are SERVER routes and are`r`n" +
           "// intentionally unchanged; renaming them is separate backend debt.`r`n" +
           "// ============================================================`r`n"
    Write-NoBom $apiNewPath ($hdr + $api)
    Remove-Item $apiOldPath -Force
    Write-Host '  renamed: api/phase8Assistant.ts -> api/assistantApi.ts' -ForegroundColor Green

    foreach ($rel in @($CfgPageRel, $RunPageRel, $SugPageRel, $TestRel)) {
        $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
        $t = $t.Replace('@/api/phase8Assistant', '@/api/assistantApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('../../api/phase8Assistant', '../../api/assistantApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('phase8AssistantApi', 'assistantApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfigSaveResponse', 'AssistantConfigSaveResponse')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfiguration', 'AssistantConfiguration')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantCitation', 'AssistantCitation')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantAnswer', 'AssistantAnswer')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRecommendation', 'SuggestionRecommendation')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRequest', 'SuggestionRequest')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8SuggestionResponse', 'SuggestionResponse')
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, $Utf8NoBom)
    }
    Write-Host '  patched: 3 pages + 1 test import assistantApi' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch { Write-Host ('FAILED api rename: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. App.tsx
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try {
    $appPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $AppRel
    $app = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($appPath)

    # --- 2a. Remove the dead unreachable /suggestions -> DemoAnalyticsSuggestionsPage route.
    #     MUST run before the alias rewrites (they use last-occurrence semantics).
    $deadMarker = '<SuggestionsPage />'
    if ($app.Contains($deadMarker)) {
        $mIdx = $app.IndexOf($deadMarker)
        $routeStart = $app.LastIndexOf('<Route', $mIdx)
        $e1 = $app.IndexOf('/>', $mIdx)                    # closes <SuggestionsPage />
        $e2 = if ($e1 -ge 0) { $app.IndexOf('/>', $e1 + 2) } else { -1 }   # closes <Route ... />
        if ($routeStart -lt 0 -or $e2 -lt 0) { throw 'could not bound the dead SuggestionsPage route.' }
        $app = $app.Remove($routeStart, ($e2 + 2) - $routeStart)
        Write-Host '  removed: dead unreachable /suggestions -> DemoAnalyticsSuggestionsPage (Golden Rule)' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    $lazyMarker = 'const SuggestionsPage = lazy(() =>'
    if ($app.Contains($lazyMarker)) {
        $lIdx = $app.IndexOf($lazyMarker)
        $lEnd = $app.IndexOf(');', $lIdx)
        if ($lEnd -gt 0) {
            $app = $app.Remove($lIdx, ($lEnd + 2) - $lIdx)
            Write-Host '  removed: unused SuggestionsPage lazy import' -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    }

    # --- 2b. Reverse each aliased pair.
    #     Canonical route always precedes its alias route in the file, so:
    #       first  path="old"   = the canonical  -> becomes "new"
    #       last   path="alias" = the alias      -> becomes "old"  (the redirect)
    #       to="old"                             -> "new"          (alias now points at new)
    $aliased = @(
        @{ Old = '/phase8/assistant-config';       New = '/assistant/configuration';        Alias = '/assistant-config' },
        @{ Old = '/phase8/assistant';              New = '/assistant';                      Alias = '/assistant' },
        @{ Old = '/phase8/suggestions';            New = '/suggestions';                    Alias = '/suggestions' },
        @{ Old = '/phase9/executive';              New = '/executive';                      Alias = '/executive' },
        @{ Old = '/phase10/license';               New = '/license';                        Alias = '/license-demo' },
        @{ Old = '/phase15/honesty-certification'; New = '/advisory/honesty-certification'; Alias = '/advisory/honesty-certification' },
        @{ Old = '/phase15/benchmarking';          New = '/advisory/benchmarking';          Alias = '/advisory/benchmarking' },
        @{ Old = '/phase15/roi-cfo-dashboard';     New = '/advisory/roi-cfo-dashboard';     Alias = '/advisory/roi-cfo-dashboard' },
        @{ Old = '/phase15/value-realization';     New = '/advisory/value-realization';     Alias = '/advisory/value-realization' },
        @{ Old = '/phase15/recommendations';       New = '/advisory/recommendations';       Alias = '/advisory/recommendations' },
        @{ Old = '/phase15/scenario-simulation';   New = '/advisory/scenario-simulation';   Alias = '/advisory/scenario-simulation' }
    )

    foreach ($m in $aliased) {
        $old = $m.Old; $new = $m.New; $alias = $m.Alias
        $app = Replace-First $app ('path="' + $old + '"')   ('path="' + $new + '"')   ('App.tsx canonical ' + $old)
        $app = $app.Replace('"' + $old + '",', '"' + $new + '",')                       # withPageBoundary first arg
        $app = Replace-Last  $app ('path="' + $alias + '"') ('path="' + $old + '"')   ('App.tsx alias ' + $alias)
        $app = $app.Replace('to="' + $old + '"', 'to="' + $new + '"')                   # its <Navigate> target
        Write-Host ('  route: ' + $old + ' -> ' + $new + '  (redirect kept)') -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    # --- 2c. /phase9/access had NO alias: rename canonical, redirect appended below.
    $app = Replace-First $app 'path="/phase9/access"' 'path="/access-matrix"' 'App.tsx /phase9/access'
    $app = $app.Replace('"/phase9/access",', '"/access-matrix",')
    Write-Host '  route: /phase9/access -> /access-matrix  (redirect appended)' -ForegroundColor Green

    # --- 2d. Append the redirects that have no home yet, just before </Routes>.
    $appendBlock = @'
                    {/* M1-08: legacy path redirects (Naming Golden Rule) */}
                    <Route path="/phase9/access" element={<Navigate to="/access-matrix" replace />} />
                    <Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />
                    <Route path="/license-demo" element={<Navigate to="/license" replace />} />
                  </Routes>
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n" -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    if (-not $app.Contains('</Routes>')) { throw '</Routes> not found in App.tsx' }
    $app = Replace-Last $app '</Routes>' $appendBlock.TrimStart() 'App.tsx </Routes>'
    Write-Host '  appended: 3 legacy redirects before </Routes>' -ForegroundColor Green

    # --- 2e. Loading labels.
    $labels = @{
        '"Phase 8 suggestions are refreshing"'             = '"Suggestions are refreshing"'
        '"Phase 8 assistant is refreshing"'                = '"Assistant is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 8 assistant configuration is refreshing"'  = '"Assistant configuration is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 10 license demo is refreshing"'            = '"License page is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 15 honesty certification is refreshing"'   = '"Honesty certification is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 15 benchmarking is refreshing"'            = '"Benchmarking is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 15 ROI/CFO dashboard is refreshing"'       = '"ROI/CFO dashboard is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 15 value realization is refreshing"'       = '"Value realization is refreshing"'
        '"Phase 15 recommendations are refreshing"'        = '"Recommendations are refreshing"'
        '"Phase 15 scenario simulation is refreshing"'     = '"Scenario simulation is refreshing"'
    }
    foreach ($k in $labels.Keys) { $app = $app.Replace($k, $labels[$k]) }
    Write-Host '  patched: 10 loading labels de-phased' -ForegroundColor Green

    # --- 2f. Lazy const identifiers.
    #     CAREFUL: Phase10LicenseDemoPage and Phase7ValueScenarioPage appear INSIDE
    #     their own import paths ("./pages/Phase10/Phase10LicenseDemoPage") and as the
    #     exported symbol (m.Phase10LicenseDemoPage). A blind Replace would corrupt
    #     module resolution. So rename ONLY the const declaration and the JSX usage.
    $consts = @(
        @('Phase10LicenseDemoPage','LicenseDemoPage'),
        @('Phase9ExecutivePersonaDashboardPage','ExecutivePersonaDashboardPage'),
        @('Phase9PersonaAccessMatrixPage','PersonaAccessMatrixPage'),
        @('Phase8AssistantConfigurationPage','AssistantConfigurationPage'),
        @('Phase8AssistantRuntimePage','AssistantRuntimePage'),
        @('Phase8SuggestionRecommendationPage','SuggestionRecommendationPage'),
        @('Phase7ValueScenarioPage','ValueScenarioPage')
    )
    foreach ($c in $consts) {
        $old = $c[0]; $new = $c[1]
        $app = $app.Replace(('const ' + $old + ' = lazy'), ('const ' + $new + ' = lazy'))
        $app = $app.Replace(('<' + $old + ' />'), ('<' + $new + ' />'))
    }
    Write-Host '  patched: 7 lazy const identifiers de-phased (decl + usage only)' -ForegroundColor Green

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($appPath, $app, $Utf8NoBom)
    Write-Host '  patched: App.tsx' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch { Write-Host ('FAILED App.tsx: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }

try {

$GateContent = @'
// ============================================================
// M1-08 STRICT GATE - Naming Golden Rule, no allowlist.
// "Zero phase tokens in any canonical route, period."
//
// Redirects ARE permitted to name the old /phaseN/* paths: that is precisely
// their job (keeping old links alive). A canonical route is any <Route> whose
// element is not a <Navigate>.
//
// Parsing note: this gate splits App.tsx on "<Route" so each chunk is exactly
// one route. An earlier version used a fixed 240-char lookahead and silently
// missed whitespace-heavy routes; do not reintroduce that.
// ============================================================
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";

const webRoot = resolve(__dirname, "../../..");
const read = (rel: string): string => {
  const p = resolve(webRoot, rel);
  return existsSync(p) ? readFileSync(p, "utf8") : "";
};

const PHASE_IN_PATH = /\/phase\d+\//i;

describe("M1-08 Naming Golden Rule: zero phase tokens on the demo path", () => {
  it("the assistant api file is not phase-named", () => {
    expect(existsSync(resolve(webRoot, "src/api/assistantApi.ts"))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(resolve(webRoot, "src/api/phase8Assistant.ts"))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("no canonical route path contains a phase token", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    expect(app.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const offenders: string[] = [];
    // Each chunk after splitting on "<Route" is exactly one route element, so a
    // <Navigate> inside the chunk means this route IS a redirect.
    for (const chunk of app.split("<Route").slice(1)) {
      const pathMatch = /path="([^"]+)"/.exec(chunk);
      if (!pathMatch) continue;
      const routePath = pathMatch[1];
      const isRedirect = chunk.includes("<Navigate");
      if (!isRedirect && PHASE_IN_PATH.test(routePath)) {
        offenders.push(`canonical route "${routePath}" still carries a phase token`);
      }
    }
    expect(offenders, `M1-08:\n  ${offenders.join("\n  ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("no loading label announces a phase number", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    const bad = app.match(/"Phase\s+\d+[^"]*"/g) ?? [];
    expect(bad, `M1-08 phase-named loading labels: ${bad.join(", ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("no nav target or nav label carries a phase token", () => {
    const layout = read("src/components/AppLayout.tsx");
    expect(layout.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const badTargets: string[] = [];
    const toRe = /to:\s*"([^"]+)"/g;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = toRe.exec(layout)) !== null) {
      if (PHASE_IN_PATH.test(m[1])) badTargets.push(`nav target "${m[1]}"`);
    }
    expect(badTargets, `M1-08: ${badTargets.join(", ")}`).toHaveLength(0);

    const badLabels: string[] = [];
    const labelRe = /label:\s*"([^"]+)"/g;
    while ((m = labelRe.exec(layout)) !== null) {
      if (/\bP\d{2}\b|phase\s*\d+/i.test(m[1])) badLabels.push(`nav label "${m[1]}"`);
    }
    expect(badLabels, `M1-08: ${badLabels.join(", ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("the legacy phase paths still redirect (no broken bookmarks)", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    const mustRedirect = [
      ["/phase8/assistant", "/assistant"],
      ["/phase8/assistant-config", "/assistant/configuration"],
      ["/phase8/suggestions", "/suggestions"],
      ["/phase9/executive", "/executive"],
      ["/phase9/access", "/access-matrix"],
      ["/phase10/license", "/license"],
      ["/phase15/honesty-certification", "/advisory/honesty-certification"],
      ["/phase15/benchmarking", "/advisory/benchmarking"],
      ["/phase15/roi-cfo-dashboard", "/advisory/roi-cfo-dashboard"],
      ["/phase15/value-realization", "/advisory/value-realization"],
      ["/phase15/recommendations", "/advisory/recommendations"],
      ["/phase15/scenario-simulation", "/advisory/scenario-simulation"],
    ];
    const missing: string[] = [];
    for (const [from, to] of mustRedirect) {
      const re = new RegExp(`path="${from}"[\\s\\S]{0,160}?to="${to}"`);
      if (!re.test(app)) missing.push(`${from} -> ${to}`);
    }
    expect(missing, `M1-08 broken redirects: ${missing.join(", ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("the canonical descriptive routes exist", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    for (const p of ["/assistant", "/assistant/configuration", "/suggestions", "/access-matrix", "/advisory/benchmarking"]) {
      expect(app, `missing canonical route ${p}`).toContain(`path="${p}"`);
    }
  });
});
'@

Write-NoBom (Join-Path $RepoRoot $GateRel) $GateContent
Write-Host '  created: strict grep gate (no allowlist)' -ForegroundColor Green

if (-not $SkipFrontend) {

    Write-Host 'tsc GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host '=== FULL architecture suite ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $WebRoot
    & cmd /c "npx vitest run src/test/architecture/"
    $gateExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($gateExit -ne 0) { Write-Host 'ARCHITECTURE GATES FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Architecture gates GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green
}
else { Write-Host 'SkipFrontend set.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

Write-Host ''

exit 0

# ============================================================================
# Apply-M1-08-PhaseRouteRename.ps1
# PPIQ Backlog v17 task M1-08 (Important, G12, refactor, Frontend, 4h)
#   "Rename phase-named routes/components on the demo path (/phase8/assistant etc.)"
#   Acceptance: "No phase/task token in any route, nav label, or file on the demo
#   path; redirects hold; grep gate added."
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS PACK CHANGES (all frontend, user-visible surface):
#
# 1. ROUTES (src/App.tsx) - canonical names become clean; phase paths REVERSE
#    into redirects so every existing deep link / bookmark still resolves:
#       /phase8/suggestions       -> canonical /suggestions
#       /phase8/assistant         -> canonical /assistant
#       /phase8/assistant-config  -> canonical /assistant/configuration
#    Old paths kept as <Navigate replace> redirects (redirects hold).
#
# 2. DEAD DEMO ROUTE DELETED (Golden Rule):
#    App.tsx currently declares path="/suggestions" TWICE:
#      (a) ~line 1803 as a redirect to /phase8/suggestions, and
#      (b) further down as a real route rendering <SuggestionsPage />, which
#          lazy-resolves to DemoAnalyticsSuggestionsPage.
#    React Router matches (a) first, so (b) is UNREACHABLE DEAD CODE that also
#    ships a DEMO page inside the product. This pack removes route (b) and its
#    lazy import. Nothing reachable is lost; a Golden-Rule violation is removed.
#
# 3. NAV LABELS (src/components/AppLayout.tsx):
#       "P08 Suggestions"  -> "Suggestions"
#       "P08 Assistant"    -> "Assistant"
#       "Assistant Config" -> "Assistant Configuration"
#    plus the sidebar footer string "Phase 8-10 Interactive MVP" -> neutral text.
#    NAV_PHASE8_AI const -> NAV_ASSISTANT.
#
# 4. API FILE RENAME:
#       src/api/phase8Assistant.ts -> src/api/assistantApi.ts
#       export phase8AssistantApi   -> assistantApi
#       types Phase8Assistant*/Phase8Suggestion* -> Assistant*/Suggestion*
#    All 3 importers updated (AssistantConfigurationPage, AssistantRuntimePage,
#    phase8AssistantView.test.ts).
#
# 5. GREP GATE: new vitest architecture test
#       src/test/architecture/noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath.test.ts
#    Fails if any phase/task token appears in a route path, a nav label, or the
#    assistant api filename. Mirrors the existing PPIQ-T11 gate style.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE (logged, NOT done - would blow past the 4h task):
#   - BACKEND endpoint URLs /api/phase8/suggestions/*, /api/phase8/assistant-config
#     remain UNCHANGED. The api file keeps calling them verbatim. Renaming server
#     routes needs matching AccessControlMiddleware matrix entries + backend work,
#     and they are not user-visible browser URLs. Logged as separate debt.
#   - Directory renames src/pages/Phase8/, src/pages/Phase9/ (internal paths, not
#     "routes, nav labels" per the acceptance sentence).
#   - playwright.phase9.config.ts, /phase15/* advisory routes (not on the 9 demo
#     pages).
#   - _phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup/ is a BACKUP dir - never touched.
#
# Backed up, tsc + grep-gate + T11 gated, auto-revert on failure.
# RUN:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-M1-08-PhaseRouteRename.ps1
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$SkipFrontend)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRoot  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web'
if (-not (Test-Path $WebRoot)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\m1-08-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$AppRel      = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\App.tsx'
$LayoutRel   = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\components\AppLayout.tsx'
$ApiOldRel   = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\api\phase8Assistant.ts'
$ApiNewRel   = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\api\assistantApi.ts'
$CfgPageRel  = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\AssistantConfigurationPage.tsx'
$RunPageRel  = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\AssistantRuntimePage.tsx'
$SugPageRel  = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\SuggestionRecommendationPage.tsx'
$TestRel     = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\pages\Phase8\phase8AssistantView.test.ts'
$GateRel     = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\test\architecture\noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath.test.ts'

$ToBackup = @($AppRel, $LayoutRel, $ApiOldRel, $CfgPageRel, $RunPageRel, $SugPageRel, $TestRel)
$Created  = @($ApiNewRel, $GateRel)

foreach ($rel in $ToBackup) {
    $src = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
    if (-not (Test-Path $src)) { Write-Host ('FATAL: missing ' + $rel) -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
    Copy-Item $src (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    Write-Host ('  backup: ' + $rel) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $ToBackup) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak (Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel) -Force }
    }
    foreach ($rel in $Created) {
        $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
        if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Force }
    }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Write-NoBom {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Content)
    $dir = Split-Path -Parent $Path
    if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
    $n = ($Content -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $n, $Utf8NoBom)
}

function Assert-Contains {
    param([string]$Text, [string]$Needle, [string]$Label)
    if (-not $Text.Contains($Needle)) { throw ("ANCHOR NOT FOUND in " + $Label + ": [" + $Needle + "]") }
}

Write-Host '=== M1-08: phase-route rename ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. api/phase8Assistant.ts -> api/assistantApi.ts (rename + symbol rename)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try {
    $apiOldPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $ApiOldRel
    $apiNewPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $ApiNewRel
    if (Test-Path $apiNewPath) { throw 'assistantApi.ts already exists - refusing to overwrite.' }

    $api = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($apiOldPath)

    # Symbol renames. NOTE: backend URL strings "/api/phase8/..." are deliberately
    # NOT touched (out of scope; they are server routes, not browser routes).
    $api = $api.Replace('export const phase8AssistantApi = {', 'export const assistantApi = {')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfigSaveResponse', 'AssistantConfigSaveResponse')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfiguration', 'AssistantConfiguration')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantCitation', 'AssistantCitation')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8AssistantAnswer', 'AssistantAnswer')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRecommendation', 'SuggestionRecommendation')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRequest', 'SuggestionRequest')
    $api = $api.Replace('Phase8SuggestionResponse', 'SuggestionResponse')

    $header = "// ============================================================`r`n" +
              "// FILE: Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/api/assistantApi.ts`r`n" +
              "// M1-08: renamed from phase8Assistant.ts (Naming Golden Rule).`r`n" +
              "// Backend endpoint paths (/api/phase8/...) are server routes and are`r`n" +
              "// intentionally unchanged here; renaming them is separate backend debt.`r`n" +
              "// ============================================================`r`n"
    $api = $header + $api

    Write-NoBom $apiNewPath $api
    Remove-Item $apiOldPath -Force
    Write-Host '  renamed: api/phase8Assistant.ts -> api/assistantApi.ts (+ symbol renames)' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host ('FAILED api rename: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Update the three importers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try {
    foreach ($rel in @($CfgPageRel, $RunPageRel, $SugPageRel, $TestRel)) {
        $p = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($p)
        $t = $t.Replace('@/api/phase8Assistant', '@/api/assistantApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('../../api/phase8Assistant', '../../api/assistantApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('phase8AssistantApi', 'assistantApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfigSaveResponse', 'AssistantConfigSaveResponse')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantConfiguration', 'AssistantConfiguration')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantCitation', 'AssistantCitation')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8AssistantAnswer', 'AssistantAnswer')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRecommendation', 'SuggestionRecommendation')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8SuggestionRequest', 'SuggestionRequest')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase8SuggestionResponse', 'SuggestionResponse')
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t, $Utf8NoBom)
    }
    Write-Host '  patched: 3 pages + 1 test now import assistantApi' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host ('FAILED importer update: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. AppLayout.tsx - nav labels + const rename + footer string
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try {
    $layoutPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $LayoutRel
    $lay = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($layoutPath)

    Assert-Contains $lay 'const NAV_PHASE8_AI = [' 'AppLayout.tsx'
    $lay = $lay.Replace('const NAV_PHASE8_AI = [', 'const NAV_ASSISTANT = [')
    $lay = $lay.Replace('NAV_PHASE8_AI.map', 'NAV_ASSISTANT.map')

    # Nav entries -> clean routes + clean labels
    $lay = $lay.Replace('{ to: "/phase8/suggestions", label: "P08 Suggestions", desc: "Guarded recommendations", icon: BrainCircuit },',
                        '{ to: "/suggestions", label: "Suggestions", desc: "Guarded recommendations", icon: BrainCircuit },')
    $lay = $lay.Replace('{ to: "/phase8/assistant", label: "P08 Assistant", desc: "Grounded chat runtime", icon: Sparkles },',
                        '{ to: "/assistant", label: "Assistant", desc: "Grounded chat runtime", icon: Sparkles },')
    $lay = $lay.Replace('{ to: "/phase8/assistant-config", label: "Assistant Config", desc: "HMI grounding controls", icon: Settings2 },',
                        '{ to: "/assistant/configuration", label: "Assistant Configuration", desc: "HMI grounding controls", icon: Settings2 },')

    # Footer phase string. The real file contains an en-dash (U+2013) and may be
    # stored as mojibake, so match it by regex rather than an exact ASCII literal.
    $lay = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Replace(
        $lay,
        '<span>Phase\s*8.{0,6}?10\s*Interactive\s*MVP</span>',
        '<span>Interactive workspace</span>')
    if ($lay -match 'Phase\s*8.{0,6}?10\s*Interactive\s*MVP') {
        Write-Host '  WARN: footer phase string still present - inspect AppLayout.tsx manually.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($layoutPath, $lay, $Utf8NoBom)
    Write-Host '  patched: AppLayout.tsx (nav labels, NAV_ASSISTANT, footer)' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host ('FAILED AppLayout edit: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. App.tsx - reverse the redirects, delete the dead demo /suggestions route
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
try {
    $appPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $AppRel
    $app = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($appPath)

    # --- 4a. the phase8 route block: rebuild it wholesale (unique, contiguous) ---
    $oldBlock = @'
                    <Route
                      path="/phase8/suggestions"
                      element={withPageBoundary(
                        "/phase8/suggestions",
                        "Phase 8 suggestions are refreshing",
                        <Phase8SuggestionRecommendationPage />
                      )}
                    />
                    <Route path="/suggestions" element={<Navigate to="/phase8/suggestions" replace />} />
                    <Route
                      path="/phase8/assistant"
                      element={withPageBoundary(
                        "/phase8/assistant",
                        "Phase 8 assistant is refreshing",
                        <Phase8AssistantRuntimePage />
                      )}
                    />
                    <Route path="/assistant" element={<Navigate to="/phase8/assistant" replace />} />
                    <Route
                      path="/phase8/assistant-config"
                      element={withPageBoundary(
                        "/phase8/assistant-config",
                        "Phase 8 assistant configuration is refreshing",
                        <Phase8AssistantConfigurationPage />
                      )}
                    />
                    <Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/phase8/assistant-config" replace />} />
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n" -replace "`n", "`r`n"

    $newBlock = @'
                    <Route
                      path="/suggestions"
                      element={withPageBoundary(
                        "/suggestions",
                        "Suggestions are refreshing",
                        <SuggestionRecommendationPage />
                      )}
                    />
                    <Route path="/phase8/suggestions" element={<Navigate to="/suggestions" replace />} />
                    <Route
                      path="/assistant"
                      element={withPageBoundary(
                        "/assistant",
                        "Assistant is refreshing",
                        <AssistantRuntimePage />
                      )}
                    />
                    <Route path="/phase8/assistant" element={<Navigate to="/assistant" replace />} />
                    <Route
                      path="/assistant/configuration"
                      element={withPageBoundary(
                        "/assistant/configuration",
                        "Assistant configuration is refreshing",
                        <AssistantConfigurationPage />
                      )}
                    />
                    <Route path="/phase8/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />
                    <Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n" -replace "`n", "`r`n"

    # Preflight: if the exact block is present, swap it wholesale (cleanest).
    # If the file has drifted (whitespace/format), fall back to targeted per-route
    # edits so a cosmetic difference cannot sink the whole pack.
    if ($app.Contains($oldBlock)) {
        $app = $app.Replace($oldBlock, $newBlock)
        Write-Host '  App.tsx: phase8 route block replaced wholesale.' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    else {
        Write-Host '  App.tsx: exact block not found (file drifted) - using targeted edits.' -ForegroundColor Yellow

        # ORDER MATTERS. Step 1: rename the CANONICAL routes. At this point
        # path="/phase8/..." occurs only on the canonical <Route>s; the redirects
        # carry the phase path inside to="...", so they are untouched here.
        # Longest path first so "/phase8/assistant-config" is not eaten by
        # the "/phase8/assistant" replacement.
        Assert-Contains $app 'path="/phase8/assistant-config"' 'App.tsx'
        $app = $app.Replace('path="/phase8/assistant-config"', 'path="/assistant/configuration"')
        $app = $app.Replace('"/phase8/assistant-config",', '"/assistant/configuration",')
        $app = $app.Replace('"Phase 8 assistant configuration is refreshing"', '"Assistant configuration is refreshing"')

        Assert-Contains $app 'path="/phase8/assistant"' 'App.tsx'
        $app = $app.Replace('path="/phase8/assistant"', 'path="/assistant"')
        $app = $app.Replace('"/phase8/assistant",', '"/assistant",')
        $app = $app.Replace('"Phase 8 assistant is refreshing"', '"Assistant is refreshing"')

        Assert-Contains $app 'path="/phase8/suggestions"' 'App.tsx'
        $app = $app.Replace('path="/phase8/suggestions"', 'path="/suggestions"')
        $app = $app.Replace('"/phase8/suggestions",', '"/suggestions",')
        $app = $app.Replace('"Phase 8 suggestions are refreshing"', '"Suggestions are refreshing"')

        # Step 2: NOW reverse the redirect lines. Matching on the full original
        # line (which still says path="/suggestions" ... to="/phase8/suggestions")
        # so step 1 cannot have altered it.
        $app = $app.Replace('<Route path="/suggestions" element={<Navigate to="/phase8/suggestions" replace />} />',
                            '<Route path="/phase8/suggestions" element={<Navigate to="/suggestions" replace />} />')

        $app = $app.Replace('<Route path="/assistant" element={<Navigate to="/phase8/assistant" replace />} />',
                            '<Route path="/phase8/assistant" element={<Navigate to="/assistant" replace />} />')

        $app = $app.Replace('<Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/phase8/assistant-config" replace />} />',
                            '<Route path="/phase8/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />' + "`r`n" +
                            '                    <Route path="/assistant-config" element={<Navigate to="/assistant/configuration" replace />} />')
    }

    # --- 4b. lazy import identifiers: Phase8XxxPage -> XxxPage ---
    $app = $app.Replace('const Phase8SuggestionRecommendationPage = lazy(() =>', 'const SuggestionRecommendationPage = lazy(() =>')
    $app = $app.Replace('const Phase8AssistantRuntimePage = lazy(() =>', 'const AssistantRuntimePage = lazy(() =>')
    $app = $app.Replace('const Phase8AssistantConfigurationPage = lazy(() =>', 'const AssistantConfigurationPage = lazy(() =>')

    # --- 4c. delete the dead demo /suggestions route (unreachable + Golden Rule) ---
    # It is whitespace-noisy in the file; locate by its unique element and cut the
    # enclosing <Route ...> ... /> span.
    $deadMarker = '<SuggestionsPage />'
    if ($app.Contains($deadMarker)) {
        $mIdx = $app.IndexOf($deadMarker)
        $routeStart = $app.LastIndexOf('<Route', $mIdx)
        $routeEnd = $app.IndexOf('/>', $mIdx)
        if ($routeStart -lt 0 -or $routeEnd -lt 0) { throw 'could not bound the dead SuggestionsPage route.' }
        $routeEnd = $app.IndexOf('/>', $routeEnd + 2)   # the outer Route close after element={...}
        if ($routeEnd -lt 0) { throw 'could not find dead route close.' }
        $app = $app.Remove($routeStart, ($routeEnd + 2) - $routeStart)
        Write-Host '  removed: dead unreachable /suggestions -> DemoAnalyticsSuggestionsPage route (Golden Rule)' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
    else {
        Write-Host '  no dead SuggestionsPage route found - skipping 4c.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }

    # --- 4d. remove its now-unused lazy import block ---
    $lazyMarker = 'const SuggestionsPage = lazy(() =>'
    if ($app.Contains($lazyMarker)) {
        $lIdx = $app.IndexOf($lazyMarker)
        $lEnd = $app.IndexOf(');', $lIdx)
        if ($lEnd -gt 0) {
            $app = $app.Remove($lIdx, ($lEnd + 2) - $lIdx)
            Write-Host '  removed: unused SuggestionsPage lazy import (DemoAnalyticsSuggestionsPage)' -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    }

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($appPath, $app, $Utf8NoBom)
    Write-Host '  patched: App.tsx (canonical routes + reverse redirects)' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host ('FAILED App.tsx edit: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. The grep gate (vitest architecture test, mirrors PPIQ-T11 style)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
$GateContent = @'
// ============================================================
// M1-08 grep gate: no phase/task tokens on the demo path.
// Scope (matches the M1-08 acceptance sentence): ROUTE PATHS and NAV LABELS
// in App.tsx / AppLayout.tsx, and the assistant api filename.
//
// Deliberately NOT scanned (logged debt, not this task):
//   - backend endpoint URL strings "/api/phase8/..." (server routes)
//   - internal directory names src/pages/Phase8, src/pages/Phase9
//   - /phase15/* advisory routes (not on the 9 demo pages)
//   - _phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup/ (backup dir)
// ============================================================
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";

const webRoot = resolve(__dirname, "../../..");

function read(rel: string): string {
  const p = resolve(webRoot, rel);
  return existsSync(p) ? readFileSync(p, "utf8") : "";
}

describe("M1-08 naming golden rule: no phase tokens on the demo path", () => {
  it("the assistant api file is not phase-named", () => {
    expect(existsSync(resolve(webRoot, "src/api/assistantApi.ts"))).toBe(true);
    expect(existsSync(resolve(webRoot, "src/api/phase8Assistant.ts"))).toBe(false);
  });

  it("no canonical route path contains a phase token", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    expect(app.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Canonical routes are those NOT rendered by <Navigate .../> (redirects are allowed
    // to name the old phase paths - that is how the links keep working).
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    const routeRe = /path="([^"]+)"([\s\S]{0,240}?)\/>/g;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = routeRe.exec(app)) !== null) {
      const path = m[1];
      const body = m[2];
      const isRedirect = body.includes("<Navigate");
      if (!isRedirect && /phase\d+/i.test(path)) {
        offenders.push(`canonical route path "${path}" contains a phase token`);
      }
    }
    expect(offenders, `M1-08: ${offenders.join("\n  ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("the phase8 demo-path routes redirect to their clean canonical names", () => {
    const app = read("src/App.tsx");
    expect(app).toContain('path="/assistant"');
    expect(app).toContain('path="/assistant/configuration"');
    expect(app).toContain('path="/suggestions"');
    // redirects hold
    expect(app).toContain('path="/phase8/assistant" element={<Navigate to="/assistant" replace />}');
    expect(app).toContain('path="/phase8/suggestions" element={<Navigate to="/suggestions" replace />}');
  });

  it("no nav label contains a phase or task token", () => {
    const layout = read("src/components/AppLayout.tsx");
    expect(layout.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const offenders: string[] = [];
    const labelRe = /label:\s*"([^"]+)"/g;
    let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = labelRe.exec(layout)) !== null) {
      const label = m[1];
      if (/\bP\d{2}\b|phase\s*\d+/i.test(label)) {
        offenders.push(`nav label "${label}" contains a phase token`);
      }
    }
    expect(offenders, `M1-08: ${offenders.join("\n  ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("the assistant nav routes point at the clean canonical paths", () => {
    const layout = read("src/components/AppLayout.tsx");
    expect(layout).toContain('to: "/assistant"');
    expect(layout).toContain('to: "/assistant/configuration"');
    expect(layout).toContain('to: "/suggestions"');
    expect(layout).not.toContain('to: "/phase8/');
  });
});
'@

Write-NoBom (Join-Path $RepoRoot $GateRel) $GateContent
Write-Host '  created: src/test/architecture/noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath.test.ts (grep gate)' -ForegroundColor Green

if (-not $SkipFrontend) {

    Write-Host 'tsc GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host '=== M1-08 grep gate + T11 ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $WebRoot
    & cmd /c "npx vitest run src/test/architecture/"
    $gateExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($gateExit -ne 0) { Write-Host 'ARCHITECTURE GATES FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Architecture gates GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green
}
else { Write-Host 'SkipFrontend set - run tsc + vitest before committing.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== M1-08 applied ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backups: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'MANUAL RENDER CHECK (the gates cannot prove this):'
Write-Host '  1. .\scripts\run\start-web.ps1'
Write-Host '  2. Sidebar shows: Suggestions / Assistant / Assistant Configuration'
Write-Host '  3. Visit /assistant  -> renders'
Write-Host '     Visit /phase8/assistant -> REDIRECTS to /assistant  (redirects hold)'
Write-Host '     Visit /phase8/assistant-config -> redirects to /assistant/configuration'
Write-Host '     Visit /assistant-config -> redirects to /assistant/configuration'
Write-Host '  4. Assistant page still answers (backend /api/phase8/... paths unchanged).'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'LOGGED DEBT (not done here, name it in the handover):'
Write-Host '  - backend endpoints /api/phase8/suggestions/*, /api/phase8/assistant-config'
Write-Host '  - directories src/pages/Phase8, src/pages/Phase9; playwright.phase9.config.ts'
Write-Host '  - /phase15/* advisory routes + nav (off the 9 demo pages)'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'COMMIT:'
Write-Host '  git add Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src'

exit 0

# ============================================================================
# Apply-M1-09-BackendMojibake.ps1
# Backlog v19 M1-09 (Important, G8 Hardening, Backend/Hygiene, 2h)
#
#   "Repair mojibake in the 6 backend .cs files"
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHY THIS IS NOT JUST STEP 1 POINTED AT ANOTHER FOLDER
#
# The 09-Jul frontend repair fixed 119 lines across 13 .tsx/.ts/.css files. Those
# strings render in a browser: if one had been wrong, you would see it.
#
# C# string literals are different. They can end up in:
#     - API response bodies (a corrupted message reaches the customer's screen
#       through JSON, not through a page we can eyeball)
#     - log lines and job_log rows (silently persisted)
#     - typed error codes and SQL fragments (where a changed byte is a BUG)
#
# So this pack is deliberately more paranoid than Step 1:
#   * it PRINTS EVERY LINE it intends to change, before/after, and requires
#     -Confirm to write. Read the diff. That is the 2h in the estimate.
#   * it REFUSES to touch any line that is not a pure comment or a string
#     literal - if a mojibake byte sits inside an identifier or an operator,
#     something stranger is going on and a script must not guess.
#   * it ABORTS on any line that cannot round-trip cleanly (lossy), instead of
#     doing its best. Step 1 auto-rewrote lossy COMMENT banners; here even that
#     is refused, because a .cs comment can be an XML doc comment that ships in
#     a NuGet package.
#
# ALGORITHM (identical, and proven on 129 real lines on 09-Jul)
#   Repair = encode back to Windows-1252, decode as UTF-8, repeat until clean.
#   Each pass is guarded twice: if a char cannot map to cp1252, or the bytes are
#   not valid UTF-8, the pass is REFUSED and the line is left exactly as it was.
#   Nothing is guessed.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ALSO: the CI truth gate is extended to .cs
#
# noMojibake.test.ts scans Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src only. A corrupted .cs
# file passes every gate we own. This pack adds a second `it()` to that suite
# which walks ../../Backend and fails on the same marker set. Running a backend
# scan from vitest is unusual; it is done here because that suite is ALREADY the
# gate everyone runs, and a check nobody runs is not a check.
#
# RUN (read the diff first, this is the point of the task):
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-M1-09-BackendMojibake.ps1
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-M1-09-BackendMojibake.ps1 -Confirm
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$Confirm, [switch]$SkipBuild)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$Backend  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend'
$ApiProj  = Join-Path $Backend 'PlantProcess.Api'
$GateFile = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\test\architecture\noMojibake.test.ts'
if (-not (Test-Path $Backend)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\m1-09-backend-mojibake-" + $Stamp)
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$Cp1252    = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1252)
$Utf8Strict = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(
    'utf-8',
    (New-Object System.Text.EncoderExceptionFallback),
    (New-Object System.Text.DecoderExceptionFallback))

# Broad on purpose. An under-reporting detector is worse than none.
$MarkerRegex = [regex] '[\u00C3\u00C2][\u0080-\u00FF\u2000-\u20FF\u0152-\u0178]|\u00E2[\u0080-\u30FF]'

function Test-Mojibake { param([string]$Text) return $MarkerRegex.IsMatch($Text) }

function Invoke-RepairPass {
    param([string]$Text)
    try {
        $bytes = $Cp1252.GetBytes($Text)
        # .NET substitutes '?' for unmappable chars. If the round-trip back through
        # cp1252 is not identical, a character was lost -> refuse the pass.
        if ($Cp1252.GetString($bytes) -ne $Text) { return $null }
        return $Utf8Strict.GetString($bytes)
    }
    catch { return $null }
}

function Repair-Line {
    param([string]$Line)
    $cur = $Line
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 15; $i++) {
        if (-not (Test-Mojibake $cur)) { break }
        $next = Invoke-RepairPass $cur
        if ($null -eq $next -or $next -eq $cur) { break }
        $cur = $next
    }
    return $cur
}

# A line is safe to touch only if every mojibake character sits inside a comment
# or inside a double-quoted string. Anything else means the corruption is in code.
function Test-SafeLine {
    param([string]$Line)
    $t = $Line.TrimStart()
    if ($t.StartsWith('//') -or $t.StartsWith('*') -or $t.StartsWith('/*')) { return $true }
    # crude but conservative: the line must contain a quote, and the first marker
    # must appear after the first quote.
    $q = $Line.IndexOf('"')
    if ($q -lt 0) { return $false }
    $m = $MarkerRegex.Match($Line)
    return ($m.Success -and $m.Index -gt $q)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SCAN
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '=== M1-09: backend mojibake scan ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $Backend -Recurse -File |
    Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq '.cs' } |
    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\bin\\|\\obj\\|\\Migrations\\.*Designer\.cs$' }

if (@($files).Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'FATAL: scanned 0 .cs files - refusing to report a false clean.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Write-Host ('scanned .cs files: ' + @($files).Count)

$plan       = @()   # each: File, LineNo, Before, After
$unsafe     = @()
$lossy      = @()

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName)
    if (-not (Test-Mojibake $text)) { continue }
    $lines = $text -split "`r?`n"
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
        $line = $lines[$i]
        if (-not (Test-Mojibake $line)) { continue }
        $rel = $file.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)

        if (-not (Test-SafeLine $line)) {
            $unsafe += [pscustomobject]@{ File = $rel; Line = ($i + 1); Text = $line.Trim() }
            continue
        }
        $fixed = Repair-Line $line
        if (Test-Mojibake $fixed) {
            $lossy += [pscustomobject]@{ File = $rel; Line = ($i + 1); Text = $line.Trim() }
            continue
        }
        $plan += [pscustomobject]@{ File = $file.FullName; Rel = $rel; LineNo = ($i + 1); Before = $line; After = $fixed }
    }
}

# Set-StrictMode 2.0 makes property access on an EMPTY array a hard error, so
# $unsafe.File throws when $unsafe is @(). Project through ForEach-Object, which
# yields nothing on an empty collection instead of throwing.
$allTouched = @()
$allTouched += @($plan   | ForEach-Object { $_.Rel })
$allTouched += @($unsafe | ForEach-Object { $_.File })
$allTouched += @($lossy  | ForEach-Object { $_.File })
$fileCount = @($allTouched | Select-Object -Unique).Count

$planCount   = @($plan).Count
$lossyCount  = @($lossy).Count
$unsafeCount = @($unsafe).Count

Write-Host ''
Write-Host ('files with mojibake : ' + $fileCount)
Write-Host ('lines repairable    : ' + $planCount) -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('lines LOSSY         : ' + $lossyCount) -ForegroundColor $(if ($lossyCount -gt 0) { 'Red' } else { 'Green' })
Write-Host ('lines UNSAFE (code) : ' + $unsafeCount) -ForegroundColor $(if ($unsafeCount -gt 0) { 'Red' } else { 'Green' })

foreach ($u in $unsafe) { Write-Host ('  !! UNSAFE ' + $u.File + ':' + $u.Line + '  ' + $u.Text) -ForegroundColor Red }
foreach ($l in $lossy)  { Write-Host ('  !! LOSSY  ' + $l.File + ':' + $l.Line + '  ' + $l.Text) -ForegroundColor Red }

if ($planCount -eq 0 -and $unsafeCount -eq 0 -and $lossyCount -eq 0) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'No mojibake in Backend/**/*.cs. Nothing to repair.' -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host 'Re-run with -Confirm to still install the CI gate extension.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (-not $Confirm) { exit 0 }
}

if ($unsafeCount -gt 0 -or $lossyCount -gt 0) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'ABORTING: a corrupted byte sits in code, or a line cannot round-trip.' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'A .cs literal can reach an API response, a log row, or a SQL fragment.' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'Tell me what those lines should read and I will fix them explicitly.' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE DIFF - this is the deliverable. Read it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== EVERY LINE THIS PACK WOULD CHANGE ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$lastFile = ''
foreach ($p in $plan) {
    if ($p.Rel -ne $lastFile) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('--- ' + $p.Rel) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $lastFile = $p.Rel }
    Write-Host ('  ' + $p.LineNo)
    Write-Host ('    - ' + $p.Before.Trim()) -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ('    + ' + $p.After.Trim())  -ForegroundColor Green
}

if (-not $Confirm) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'DRY RUN. Nothing was written.' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host 'Read the diff above. Every one of those lines can end up in a customer-visible' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host 'API response or a persisted log row. When you are satisfied:' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host '  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-M1-09-BackendMojibake.ps1 -Confirm' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# APPLY
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$changed = @()
foreach ($rel in ($plan | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Rel -Unique)) {
    $full = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
    Copy-Item $full (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    $changed += $rel
}
if (Test-Path $GateFile) { Copy-Item $GateFile (Join-Path $BackupDir 'noMojibake.test.ts') -Force }

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $changed) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak (Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel) -Force }
    }
    $g = Join-Path $BackupDir 'noMojibake.test.ts'
    if (Test-Path $g) { Copy-Item $g $GateFile -Force }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Get-Process PlantProcess.Api, dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

foreach ($rel in $changed) {
    $full  = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
    $text  = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full)
    $crlf  = $text.Contains("`r`n")
    $lines = $text -split "`r?`n"
    foreach ($p in ($plan | Where-Object { $_.Rel -eq $rel })) {
        $idx = $p.LineNo - 1
        if ($lines[$idx] -ne $p.Before) { Restore-All; Write-Host ('ABORT: ' + $rel + ':' + $p.LineNo + ' changed under us.') -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
        $lines[$idx] = $p.After
    }
    $joiner = if ($crlf) { "`r`n" } else { "`n" }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, ($lines -join $joiner), $Utf8NoBom)
    Write-Host ('  repaired: ' + $rel) -ForegroundColor Green
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CI GATE: extend noMojibake to .cs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (Test-Path $GateFile) {
    $gate = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($GateFile)
    if (-not $gate.Contains('BACKEND .cs')) {
        $append = @'

// ============================================================
// BACKEND .cs
// A corrupted C# literal passes every gate we own: noMojibake scanned only
// Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src. A .cs string can reach an API response body, a
// job_log row, or a SQL fragment, where a changed byte is a bug rather than an
// eyesore. Scanning the backend from vitest is unusual - it is done here because
// this suite is the gate everyone already runs, and a check nobody runs is not
// a check. Move it to a C# analyzer when one exists.
// ============================================================
describe("encoding: no mojibake in backend C# sources", () => {
  it("no .cs file contains UTF-8-as-cp1252 corruption", () => {
    const backendRoot = resolve(srcRoot, "../../../Backend");
    if (!existsSync(backendRoot)) return; // frontend-only checkout

    const skip = /[\\/](bin|obj)[\\/]|\.Designer\.cs$/;
    const files: string[] = [];
    const walkCs = (dir: string): void => {
      for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
        const full = join(dir, entry);
        if (skip.test(full)) continue;
        if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walkCs(full);
        else if (full.endsWith(".cs")) files.push(full);
      }
    };
    walkCs(backendRoot);
    expect(files.length, "scanned 0 .cs files - a false clean").toBeGreaterThan(0);

    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for (const file of files) {
      readFileSync(file, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line, i) => {
        if (MOJIBAKE.test(line)) {
          offenders.push(`${file.replace(backendRoot, "Backend")}:${i + 1}: ${line.trim().slice(0, 60)}`);
        }
      });
    }
    expect(offenders, `Mojibake in backend sources:\n  ${offenders.join("\n  ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});
'@
        # The Step-1 gate already imports readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, resolve
        # and join. It does NOT import existsSync, which the backend check needs to
        # tolerate a frontend-only checkout. Add exactly that, and nothing else.
        $fsImport = 'import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";'
        if (-not $gate.Contains($fsImport)) { throw 'noMojibake.test.ts import line has drifted; refusing to patch it blind.' }
        if (-not $gate.Contains('existsSync')) {
            $gate = $gate.Replace($fsImport, 'import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";')
        }
        $norm = (($append -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n")
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($GateFile, ($gate.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $norm), $Utf8NoBom)
        Write-Host '  extended: noMojibake.test.ts (+ backend .cs scan)' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SELF-CHECK + GATES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$residual = @()
foreach ($rel in $changed) {
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel))
    if (Test-Mojibake $t) { $residual += ($rel + ' still contains mojibake') }
}
if (@($residual).Count -gt 0) {
    foreach ($r in $residual) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $r) -ForegroundColor Red }
    Restore-All; exit 1
}
Write-Host '  self-check: 0 markers left in the repaired files' -ForegroundColor Green

if (-not $SkipBuild) {
    Write-Host '=== Build gate: dotnet build ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & dotnet build (Join-Path $ApiProj 'PlantProcess.Api.csproj') -c Debug --nologo
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'BUILD FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Backend build GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host '=== Frontend architecture suite (the extended gate) ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web')
    & cmd /c "npx vitest run src/test/architecture/noMojibake.test.ts"
    $g = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($g -ne 0) { Write-Host 'GATE FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Mojibake gate GREEN (frontend + backend).' -ForegroundColor Green
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== M1-09 COMPLETE ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backups: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ('Files repaired: ' + @($changed).Count + '  Lines: ' + $planCount)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'REVIEW THE DIFF IN GIT before committing. Every changed line was a string'
Write-Host 'literal or a comment - the pack refuses to touch anything else - but a literal'
Write-Host 'can be an error code, a SQL fragment, or a message a customer reads.'
Write-Host '  git diff -- Backend'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'PROVE THE GATE BITES:'
Write-Host '  add a corrupted line to any .cs (paste a UTF-8 middot that was saved as cp1252), then'
Write-Host '  npx vitest run src/test/architecture/noMojibake.test.ts   -> RED, naming the file'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'COMMIT:'
Write-Host '  git add Backend Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src/test/architecture/noMojibake.test.ts'
Write-Host '  git commit -m "M1-09: repair UTF-8-as-cp1252 mojibake in backend C# sources; extend the noMojibake truth gate to scan .cs"'
exit 0

# ============================================================================
# Apply-M1-10-LogPanelSearchAndSystemLog.ps1
# Backlog v17 M1-10 (Very important, G15 Observability UX, 4h)
#
#   "LogPanel: free-text word filter + system-vs-job log source toggle"
#
# Plus, at Karim's instruction: src\security\phase9RoleAccess.ts is renamed.
# No source file should carry a phase, task or pack id.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE CARD SAYS "Frontend". IT IS NOT.
#
#   (a) free-text search must filter server-side  -> GET /admin/job-logs?q=
#   (b) the system log lives in a FILE, not the DB -> a NEW endpoint is required
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BACKEND
#
# 1. GetJobLogsAsync gains `q`:
#        AND (message ILIKE @q OR job_name ILIKE @q)
#    Parameterised. The existing jobName/severity/day/paging behaviour is untouched.
#
# 2. NEW: GET /admin/system-logs?day=&hour=&severity=&q=&limit=
#
#    Serilog writes AppContext.BaseDirectory/logs/systemlog_.log with
#    RollingInterval.Hour, producing systemlog_YYYYMMDDHH.log, and the template
#        [{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} {Level:u3}] [Machine] ...
#    so each line begins  [2026-07-09 14:05:22.117 +02:00 INF]  with a
#    three-letter level: VRB DBG INF WRN ERR FTL.
#
#    SECURITY - this endpoint reads files from disk on an admin route:
#      * the client NEVER supplies a path or a filename. It supplies a date and
#        an integer hour. The filename is built from those.
#      * day is DateOnly, hour is an int clamped to 0..23. Neither can contain
#        a separator, a dot, or "..".
#      * the composed path is Path.GetFullPath'd and asserted to still sit
#        under the resolved log directory. A mismatch returns 400, not the file.
#      * the file is opened FileShare.ReadWrite because Serilog holds it open
#        (shared: true), and only the LAST `limit` lines are returned
#        (default 500, hard cap 2000). An hour of Verbose logging is large.
#      * the group already carries .RequireAuthorization("PlantProcessAdmin"),
#        and AccessControlMiddleware's ("/admin", All(), "tenant.admin") entry
#        covers this path by longest-prefix. No matrix change is needed.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FRONTEND
#
#   LogPanel gains a Source toggle (Job events | System log) and a free-text
#   search box. The existing jobType / severity / day filters and the 10s poll
#   are preserved; filters combine. System-log lines render with the same
#   severity colouring as job events.
#
#   The search box debounces (350ms) so a keystroke does not become a query.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ALSO: src\security\phase9RoleAccess.ts -> src\security\roleAccess.ts
#   Every importer is discovered from disk and rewritten. Nothing is assumed.
#
#   NOT renamed here (each is bound to a stylesheet whose class names must move
#   in the same commit, which is its own pack):
#       pages\Phase8\phase8-ai.css        pages\Phase9\phase9-personas.css
#       pages\Phase7ValueScenario\phase7-value-scenario.css
#       src\phase11\*                      pages\Phase8\  pages\Phase9\
#
# PREFLIGHT verifies every anchor. Backed up, dotnet build + tsc + full suite
# gated, auto-revert on failure.
# RUN: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-M1-10-LogPanelSearchAndSystemLog.ps1
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$SkipBuild, [switch]$SkipFrontend)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRoot  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web'
$SrcRoot  = Join-Path $WebRoot 'src'
$ApiProj  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api'
if (-not (Test-Path $SrcRoot)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\m1-10-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$AdminCs   = Join-Path $ApiProj 'Endpoints\Admin\AdminEndpoints.cs'
$LogPanel  = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'components\logging\LogPanel.tsx'
$LogCss    = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'components\logging\log-panel.css'
$RoleOld   = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'security\phase9RoleAccess.ts'
$RoleNew   = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'security\roleAccess.ts'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREFLIGHT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '=== M1-10 preflight ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$missing = @()
foreach ($p in @($AdminCs, $LogPanel, $LogCss, $RoleOld)) { if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { $missing += ('missing ' + $p) } }
if (Test-Path $RoleNew) { $missing += 'src\security\roleAccess.ts already exists' }

$cs = if (Test-Path $AdminCs) { [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($AdminCs) } else { '' }

$csAnchors = @(
    'using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;',
    '"FROM public.job_log WHERE 1 = 1";',
    '    private static async Task<IResult> GetJobLogsAsync(' + "`r`n" + '        string? jobType,',
    '       group.MapGet("/jobs-monitor", GetJobsMonitorAsync)',
    'if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jobName)) { sql += " AND job_name ILIKE @jobName"; AddParam("jobName", "%" + jobName + "%"); }'
)
foreach ($a in $csAnchors) { if (-not $cs.Contains($a)) { $missing += ('AdminEndpoints.cs :: ' + $a.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(60, $a.Length))) } }

if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'PREFLIGHT FAILED - nothing changed:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($m in $missing) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $m) -ForegroundColor Red }
    exit 1
}

# Who imports the role map?
$roleImporters = @()
Get-ChildItem $SrcRoot -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.ts', '.tsx' } |
    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '_phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup' } | ForEach-Object {
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName)
        if ($t -match 'phase9RoleAccess') { $roleImporters += $_.FullName }
    }
Write-Host ('All anchors present. phase9RoleAccess importers: ' + $roleImporters.Count) -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BACKUP
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$BackupList = @()
function Backup-One {
    param([string]$Full)
    if (-not (Test-Path $Full)) { return }
    $rel = $Full.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)
    Copy-Item $Full (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    $script:BackupList += $rel
}
foreach ($p in @($AdminCs, $LogPanel, $LogCss, $RoleOld)) { Backup-One $p }
foreach ($p in $roleImporters) { Backup-One $p }

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $BackupList) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak (Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel) -Force }
    }
    if (Test-Path $RoleNew) { Remove-Item $RoleNew -Force }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
function Save-Text { param([string]$Path, [string]$Text) [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, (($Text -replace "`r`n","`n") -replace "`n","`r`n"), $Utf8NoBom) }

Write-Host 'Stopping API (file lock guard)...'
Get-Process PlantProcess.Api, dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

try {
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. BACKEND: q filter + system-logs endpoint
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $t = $cs

    $t = $t.Replace('using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;',
                    'using System.Text.RegularExpressions;' + "`r`n" + 'using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;')

    # q parameter on the job-log query
    $t = $t.Replace('    private static async Task<IResult> GetJobLogsAsync(' + "`r`n" + '        string? jobType,',
                    '    private static async Task<IResult> GetJobLogsAsync(' + "`r`n" + '        string? jobType,' + "`r`n" + '        string? q,')

    $t = $t.Replace('if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jobName)) { sql += " AND job_name ILIKE @jobName"; AddParam("jobName", "%" + jobName + "%"); }',
                    'if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jobName)) { sql += " AND job_name ILIKE @jobName"; AddParam("jobName", "%" + jobName + "%"); }' + "`r`n" +
                    '        // M1-10: free-text word filter across the message and the job name.' + "`r`n" +
                    '        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q)) { sql += " AND (message ILIKE @q OR job_name ILIKE @q)"; AddParam("q", "%" + q.Trim() + "%"); }')

    # map the new endpoint
    $mapAnchor = '       group.MapGet("/jobs-monitor", GetJobsMonitorAsync)'
    $mapNew = '        group.MapGet("/system-logs", GetSystemLogsAsync)' + "`r`n" +
              '            .WithSummary("Tail the hourly system log")' + "`r`n" +
              '            .WithDescription("Reads logs/systemlog_YYYYMMDDHH.log. The client supplies a date and an hour, never a path.");' + "`r`n" + "`r`n" +
              $mapAnchor
    $t = $t.Replace($mapAnchor, $mapNew)

    # the endpoint itself, inserted after the job-log response record
    $recAnchor = @'
    private sealed record JobLogEntryResponse(
        Guid Id,
        DateTime OccurredAtUtc,
        string JobType,
        string JobName,
        Guid? RunId,
        string Severity,
        string Message,
        string Context,
        string? SiteCode);
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n" -replace "`n", "`r`n"

    $sysEndpoint = @'

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // M1-10: hourly system-log tail.
    //
    // Serilog writes AppContext.BaseDirectory/logs/systemlog_.log with
    // RollingInterval.Hour -> systemlog_YYYYMMDDHH.log, using the template
    //     [{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} {Level:u3}] [Machine] ...
    // Level:u3 emits VRB DBG INF WRN ERR FTL.
    //
    // The CLIENT NEVER SUPPLIES A PATH. It supplies a date and an integer hour;
    // the filename is composed here. The composed path is then resolved and
    // asserted to remain inside the log directory before a single byte is read.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    private static readonly Regex SystemLogLineRegex = new(
        @"^\[(?<ts>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{3}[^\]]*?) (?<lvl>VRB|DBG|INF|WRN|ERR|FTL)\]\s*(?<rest>.*)$",
        RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private static string MapSerilogLevel(string level) => level switch
    {
        "FTL" => "Error",
        "ERR" => "Error",
        "WRN" => "Warning",
        "INF" => "Info",
        _ => "Debug"
    };

    private static IResult GetSystemLogsAsync(
        DateOnly? day,
        int? hour,
        string? severity,
        string? q,
        int? limit)
    {
        var maxLines = Math.Clamp(limit ?? 500, 1, 2000);
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var theDay = day ?? DateOnly.FromDateTime(now);
        var theHour = Math.Clamp(hour ?? now.Hour, 0, 23);

        // day/hour are strongly typed; a filename built from them cannot contain
        // a separator, a dot or "..". The guard below is belt and braces.
        var stamp = theDay.ToString("yyyyMMdd") + theHour.ToString("00");
        var fileName = "systemlog_" + stamp + ".log";

        var logDirectory = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "logs"));
        var candidate = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(logDirectory, fileName));

        if (!candidate.StartsWith(logDirectory + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return Results.BadRequest(new { message = "Resolved log path escaped the log directory." });
        }

        if (!File.Exists(candidate))
        {
            return Results.Ok(new
            {
                file = fileName,
                exists = false,
                count = 0,
                entries = Array.Empty<SystemLogEntryResponse>(),
                message = "No system log for that hour. The API may not have been running."
            });
        }

        var entries = new List<SystemLogEntryResponse>();
        var lineNumber = 0;

        // Serilog holds the file open with shared: true, so read it the same way.
        using (var stream = new FileStream(candidate, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite))
        using (var reader = new StreamReader(stream))
        {
            string? line;
            while ((line = reader.ReadLine()) is not null)
            {
                lineNumber++;
                var match = SystemLogLineRegex.Match(line);
                if (!match.Success)
                {
                    // Continuation line (stack trace, properties). Attach it to the last entry.
                    if (entries.Count > 0)
                    {
                        var last = entries[^1];
                        entries[^1] = last with { Message = last.Message + "\n" + line };
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                entries.Add(new SystemLogEntryResponse(
                    lineNumber,
                    match.Groups["ts"].Value,
                    MapSerilogLevel(match.Groups["lvl"].Value),
                    match.Groups["rest"].Value));
            }
        }

        IEnumerable<SystemLogEntryResponse> filtered = entries;

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(severity))
        {
            filtered = filtered.Where(e => string.Equals(e.Severity, severity, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(q))
        {
            var needle = q.Trim();
            filtered = filtered.Where(e => e.Message.Contains(needle, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        }

        var page = filtered.TakeLast(maxLines).Reverse().ToList();

        return Results.Ok(new
        {
            file = fileName,
            exists = true,
            count = page.Count,
            entries = page
        });
    }

    private sealed record SystemLogEntryResponse(
        int LineNumber,
        string Timestamp,
        string Severity,
        string Message);

/** Keystrokes must not become queries. */
function useDebounced<T>(value: T, delayMs: number): T {
  const [debounced, setDebounced] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => setDebounced(value), delayMs);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, delayMs]);
  return debounced;
}
