    $chatSrc = @'
// ============================================================
// FILE: src/components/assistant/AssistantChat.tsx
// M1-11: the conversation surface for the grounded assistant.
//
// Types come from @/api/assistantApi - this component used to redeclare them,
// which meant the wire contract and the UI could drift apart silently.
//
// Clicking a citation EXPANDS its provenance handle inline. It does not
// navigate: there is no evidence-row route in this application yet. Showing the
// handle is honest; pretending to open a row that does not exist is not.
// ============================================================
import { useState } from "react";
import { StandardButton } from "@/components/standard";
import { StandardP2Input } from "@/components/standard/StandardP2Controls";
import type { AssistantAnswer, AssistantCitation } from "@/api/assistantApi";

export type Turn = { role: "user" | "assistant"; answer?: AssistantAnswer; text?: string };

const SUGGESTED = [
  "Summarise the top risk this week",
  "What is associated with edge-crack defects?",
  "Show open suggestions by impact",
];

export function AssistantChat({
  turns,
  chips = [],
  isBusy = false,
  onAsk,
  onOpenEvidence,
}: {
  turns: Turn[];
  chips?: string[];
  isBusy?: boolean;
  onAsk?: (question: string) => void;
  onOpenEvidence?: (handle: AssistantCitation) => void;
}) {
  const [text, setText] = useState("");

  const submit = (question: string) => {
    const trimmed = question.trim();
    if (trimmed.length === 0 || isBusy) return;
    onAsk?.(trimmed);
    setText("");
  };

  return (
    <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat" data-testid="assistant-chat">
      {chips.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__chips" data-testid="context-chips">
          {chips.map((c) => (
            <span className="ppiq-assistant-chat__chip" key={c}>
              {c}
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__transcript" role="log" aria-live="polite">
        {turns.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="ppiq-assistant-chat__empty">
            Ask a question about your plant data. The assistant answers only from evidence it can
            cite, and abstains when the evidence is insufficient.
          </p>
        ) : null}

        {turns.map((t, i) =>
          t.role === "user" ? (
            <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__turn ppiq-assistant-chat__turn--user" key={i}>
              {t.text}
            </div>
          ) : t.answer ? (
            <AssistantBubble key={i} answer={t.answer} onOpenEvidence={onOpenEvidence} />
          ) : null,
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__suggestions">
        {SUGGESTED.map((s) => (
          <StandardButton key={s} type="button" isDisabled={isBusy} onClick={() => submit(s)}>
            {s}
          </StandardButton>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__composer">
        <StandardP2Input
          value={text}
          onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Ask about your approved findings..."
        />
        <StandardButton
          className="ppiq-std-button--primary"
          type="button"
          isDisabled={isBusy || text.trim().length === 0}
          isLoading={isBusy}
          onClick={() => submit(text)}
        >
          Ask
        </StandardButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AssistantBubble({
  answer,
  onOpenEvidence,
}: {
  answer: AssistantAnswer;
  onOpenEvidence?: (h: AssistantCitation) => void;
}) {
  const [openHandle, setOpenHandle] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (answer.isRefusal) {
    return (
      <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__turn ppiq-assistant-chat__turn--refusal" data-testid="assistant-refusal">
        <strong>Insufficient evidence</strong>
        <p>{answer.refusalReason ?? "I cannot answer that from approved, in-scope evidence."}</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__turn ppiq-assistant-chat__turn--answer" data-testid="assistant-answer">
      <p>{answer.text}</p>

      {answer.citations.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__citations">
          {answer.citations.map((h, i) => {
            const key = h.kind + ":" + h.id;
            const isOpen = openHandle === key;
            return (
              <div key={key + ":" + i}>
                <StandardButton
                  type="button"
                  data-testid="assistant-citation"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setOpenHandle(isOpen ? null : key);
                    onOpenEvidence?.(h);
                  }}
                >
                  Source: {h.kind} ({h.id.slice(0, 8)})
                </StandardButton>
                {isOpen ? (
                  <dl className="ppiq-assistant-chat__evidence" data-testid="assistant-evidence">
                    <dt>Kind</dt>
                    <dd>{h.kind}</dd>
                    <dt>Identifier</dt>
                    <dd>{h.id}</dd>
                    {h.detail ? (
                      <>
                        <dt>Detail</dt>
                        <dd>{h.detail}</dd>
                      </>
                    ) : null}
                  </dl>
                ) : null}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="ppiq-assistant-chat__nocite">No citations were returned for this answer.</p>
      )}

      {answer.blocked && answer.blocked.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="ppiq-assistant-chat__blocked">
          <strong>Blocked unsupported claims</strong>
          <ul>
            {answer.blocked.map((item) => (
              <li key={item}>{item}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============================================================
// FILE: src/pages/Phase8/AssistantRuntimePage.tsx
// M1-11: THE assistant page. Routed at /assistant.
//
// Holds the conversation, renders <AssistantChat/>, and wires its onAsk to
// assistantApi.askAssistant(), which is the ONLY place the ask endpoint is
// called. (The endpoint path is deliberately not written here: the M1-11 gate
// greps src/ for it to prove nothing bypasses the api client.)
//
// If no LLM provider is configured, the backend abstains and the abstention is
// shown as an abstention. Nothing is fabricated to fill the silence.
// ============================================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { assistantModeLabel, assistantApi, type AssistantCitation, type AssistantConfiguration } from "@/api/assistantApi";
import { AssistantChat, type Turn } from "@/components/assistant/AssistantChat";
import { StandardStatGrid } from "@/components/standard";
import "./phase8-ai.css";

const CONTEXT_CHIPS = ["grounded", "approved findings"];

export function AssistantRuntimePage() {
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<AssistantConfiguration | null>(null);
  const [turns, setTurns] = useState<Turn[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState("Loading assistant runtime configuration...");

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    assistantApi
      .getAssistantConfig()
      .then((next) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setConfig(next);
        setStatus("Assistant runtime is configured.");
      })
      .catch((error: Error) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setStatus("Assistant configuration not reachable: " + error.message);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function ask(question: string) {
    setBusy(true);
    setStatus("Asking grounded assistant...");
    setTurns((prev) => [...prev, { role: "user", text: question }]);

    try {
      const result = await assistantApi.askAssistant(question, CONTEXT_CHIPS, config?.allowedTools ?? []);
      setTurns((prev) => [...prev, { role: "assistant", answer: result }]);
      setStatus(
        result.isRefusal
          ? "Assistant abstained because evidence was insufficient."
          : "Grounded answer returned with evidence.",
      );
    } catch (error) {
      setTurns((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          answer: {
            isRefusal: true,
            refusalReason: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
            text: "",
            citations: [],
            blocked: [],
          },
        },
      ]);
      setStatus("Assistant request failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function openEvidence(handle: AssistantCitation) {
    // No evidence-row route exists yet; AssistantChat expands the handle inline.
    // When a material/evidence route lands, navigate here instead.
    setStatus("Evidence handle: " + handle.kind + " " + handle.id);
  }

  const stats = [
    { label: "Mode", value: assistantModeLabel(config) },
    { label: "Grounding", value: config?.groundingPolicy ?? "pending" },
    { label: "Evidence policy", value: config?.evidencePolicy ?? "pending" },
    { label: "External egress", value: config?.noEgress ? "Blocked" : "Per configuration" },
  ];

  return (
    <main className="phase8-page" data-testid="assistant-runtime-page">
      <section className="phase8-hero">
        <p className="phase8-eyebrow">Ask questions about your plant data and receive answers with cited evidence.</p>
        <h1>Grounded Assistant</h1>
        <p className="phase8-muted">
          The assistant can answer only with grounded evidence. Missing evidence produces an
          abstention, not an invented number or an unsupported causal claim.
        </p>
        <strong className="phase8-badge">{status}</strong>
      </section>

      <StandardStatGrid items={stats} emphasize="Grounding" ariaLabel="Assistant runtime configuration" />

      <section className="phase8-two-col">
        <div className="phase8-card">
          <h2>Conversation</h2>
          <AssistantChat
            turns={turns}
            chips={CONTEXT_CHIPS}
            isBusy={busy}
            onAsk={(question) => void ask(question)}
            onOpenEvidence={openEvidence}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="phase8-card">
          <h2>Runtime guardrails</h2>
          <ul className="phase8-list">
            <li>Abstain when evidence is missing.</li>
            <li>Show citations and provenance handles.</li>
            <li>Block unsupported claims.</li>
            <li>No external egress unless configured through private endpoint mode.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

export default AssistantRuntimePage;

// ============================================================
// M1-11 gate: there is exactly ONE assistant, and it goes through the api client.
// ============================================================
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve, join } from "node:path";

const webRoot = resolve(__dirname, "../../..");
const read = (rel: string): string => {
  const p = resolve(webRoot, rel);
  return existsSync(p) ? readFileSync(p, "utf8") : "";
};

function walk(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = join(dir, entry);
    if (/node_modules|_phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup/.test(full)) continue;
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (/\.tsx?$/.test(entry)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

param(

    [string]$Profile = "local",

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$vPort = 0
if (-not [int]::TryParse($env:VITE_PORT, [ref]$vPort) -or $vPort -le 0) { $vPort = 5173 }

if ($FreePort) {
    & (Join-Path $RepoRoot "scripts\run\free-ports.ps1") -Ports @($vPort) -Force
}

Push-Location $FrontendRoot

    Write-Host ("[start-web] Vite on http://" + $vHost + ":" + $vPort + " (profile " + $Profile + ")")
    $vite = Join-Path $FrontendRoot "node_modules\.bin\vite.cmd"
    if (Test-Path $vite) {
        & $vite --host $vHost --port $vPort
    } else {
        npm run dev -- --host $vHost --port $vPort
    }
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}

using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Xunit;

namespace PlantProcess.Architecture.Tests;

/// <summary>
/// V1-41 / V1-42 source guards. These lock in the correlation run-to-result fix and the
/// stuck-run reaper at the source level so neither can silently regress: the reaper service
/// must exist and target Running rows past a max age; the learning function must NOT write
/// the phantom columns that caused the 347-zombie defect; and both silent WHEN OTHERS THEN
/// NULL swallows in that function must be gone.
/// </summary>
public sealed class CorrelationReaperSourceGuardTests
{
    private static string RepoRoot()
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null && !Directory.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "Backend")))
        {
            dir = dir.Parent;
        }
        Assert.True(dir is not null, "Could not locate repo root (Backend folder).");
        return dir!.FullName;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reaper_hosted_service_exists_and_targets_overage_running_runs()
    {
        var path = Path.Combine(RepoRoot(), "Backend", "PlantProcess.Api", "Hosting", "ComputeRunReaperHostedService.cs");
        Assert.True(File.Exists(path), "V1-41: ComputeRunReaperHostedService.cs must exist.");
        var src = File.ReadAllText(path);

        Assert.Contains("BackgroundService", src);
        Assert.Contains("ml_correlation_compute_runs", src);
        Assert.Matches(new Regex(@"status\s*=\s*'Failed'", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase), src);
        Assert.Contains("started_at_utc <", src);
        Assert.Contains("timeout", src);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reaper_is_registered_in_program()
    {
        var program = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(RepoRoot(), "Backend", "PlantProcess.Api", "Program.cs"));
        Assert.Contains("AddHostedService<PlantProcess.Api.Hosting.ComputeRunReaperHostedService>", program);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Learning_function_no_longer_writes_phantom_columns_or_swallows_errors()
    {
        var sql = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(RepoRoot(), "Backend", "database", "scripts", "204_phase04_phase05_ml_learning_core.sql"));

        // Extract the compute-run completion UPDATE and prove it targets real columns only.
        var completion = new Regex(
            @"UPDATE\s+public\.ml_correlation_compute_runs\s+SET\s+status\s*=\s*'Completed'[\s\S]*?WHERE\s+id\s*=\s*v_compute_run_id;",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
        var match = completion.Match(sql);
        Assert.True(match.Success, "V1-42: compute-run completion UPDATE not found in the learning function.");
        Assert.DoesNotContain("finished_at_utc", match.Value);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("result_count", match.Value);
        Assert.Contains("completed_at_utc", match.Value);
        Assert.Contains("duration_ms", match.Value);

        // Neither swallow may remain inside the function body.
        var fn = new Regex(
            @"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public\.ppiq_ml_run_learning_job_v1[\s\S]*?\$\$;",
            RegexOptions.IgnoreCase).Match(sql);
        Assert.True(fn.Success, "learning function body not found.");
        Assert.DoesNotContain("WHEN OTHERS THEN\n            NULL;", fn.Value.Replace("\r", ""));
    }
}

using System.Text.Json;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using PlantProcess.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using Serilog;

namespace PlantProcess.Api.Observability;

/// <summary>
/// Customer-oriented job event log (V1-45): one write lands the event in the job_log
/// table (HMI log panel + admin API) AND emits a Serilog event carrying JobLog=true,
/// which the filtered sub-logger mirrors into logs/joblog_yyyyMMddHH.log.
/// </summary>
public interface IJobLogService
{
    Task WriteAsync(
        string jobType,
        string jobName,
        Guid? runId,
        string severity,
        string message,
        object? context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

public sealed class JobLogService : IJobLogService
{
    private readonly PlantProcessDbContext _dbContext;

    public JobLogService(PlantProcessDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task WriteAsync(
        string jobType,
        string jobName,
        Guid? runId,
        string severity,
        string message,
        object? context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var contextJson = context is null ? "{}" : JsonSerializer.Serialize(context);

        await _dbContext.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync(
            "INSERT INTO public.job_log (job_type, job_name, run_id, severity, message, context) " +
            "VALUES ({0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}::jsonb)",
            new object?[] { jobType, jobName, runId, severity, message, contextJson },
            cancellationToken);

        var level = severity switch
        {
            "Error" => Serilog.Events.LogEventLevel.Error,
            "Warning" => Serilog.Events.LogEventLevel.Warning,
            _ => Serilog.Events.LogEventLevel.Information,
        };

        Log.ForContext("JobLog", true)
            .ForContext("JobType", jobType)
            .ForContext("JobName", jobName)
            .ForContext("JobRunId", runId)
            .Write(level, "{JobType} {JobName}: {JobMessage}", jobType, jobName, message);
    }
}

'@

$filterBody = @'
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Reflection;

namespace PlantProcess.Api.Observability;

/// <summary>
/// Endpoint filter that turns any job-style endpoint into a job_log event stream:
/// Started before execution, Completed with duration on success, Failed with the
/// error message on exception (rethrown - behavior is never altered).
/// </summary>
public sealed class JobLogEndpointFilter : IEndpointFilter
{
    private readonly string _jobType;

    public JobLogEndpointFilter(string jobType)
    {
        _jobType = jobType;
    }

    public async ValueTask<object?> InvokeAsync(
        EndpointFilterInvocationContext context,
        EndpointFilterDelegate next)
    {
        var services = context.HttpContext.RequestServices;
        var jobLog = services.GetService<IJobLogService>();
        var ct = context.HttpContext.RequestAborted;

        var jobName = _jobType;
        foreach (var arg in context.Arguments)
        {
            var prop = arg?.GetType().GetProperty("RequestedBy", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            var requestedBy = prop?.GetValue(arg) as string;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedBy))
            {
                jobName = _jobType + " (" + requestedBy + ")";
                break;
            }
        }

        if (jobLog is not null)
        {
            await jobLog.WriteAsync(_jobType, jobName, null, "Info", "Started", new { path = context.HttpContext.Request.Path.Value }, ct);
        }

        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        try
        {
            var result = await next(context);
            sw.Stop();
            if (jobLog is not null)
            {
                await jobLog.WriteAsync(_jobType, jobName, null, "Info", "Completed in " + sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + " ms", new { durationMs = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds }, ct);
            }
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            sw.Stop();
            if (jobLog is not null)
            {
                await jobLog.WriteAsync(_jobType, jobName, null, "Error", "Failed after " + sw.ElapsedMilliseconds + " ms: " + ex.Message, new { durationMs = sw.ElapsedMilliseconds, error = ex.GetType().Name }, CancellationToken.None);
            }
            throw;
        }
    }
}

'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($filterPath, $filterBody, $enc)

-- 252_job_event_log.sql
-- Customer-oriented job event log (V1-45). Every operational job writes Started /
-- Completed / Failed events here; the admin API + HMI log panel read it; a filtered
-- Serilog sub-logger mirrors the stream to logs/joblog_yyyyMMddHH.log hourly files.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.job_log
(
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    occurred_at_utc timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    job_type text NOT NULL,
    job_name text NOT NULL,
    run_id uuid NULL,
    severity text NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('Info', 'Warning', 'Error')),
    message text NOT NULL,
    context jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    site_code text NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_job_log_occurred
    ON public.job_log (occurred_at_utc DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_job_log_type_severity
    ON public.job_log (job_type, severity);

'@

[METADATA: Path='Apply-Phase2-MatrixFix.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='PowerShell Script', Lines=91, SizeKB=4.51, SHA256='FEA2FD4BB8D4D90425BF729D9637244457CA3DEEE90F938245723A7E0F28C284', Modified='2026-07-08 16:43:25']

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Phase2-MatrixFix.ps1
# Closes a pre-existing RBAC hole surfaced during M1-05 acceptance testing.
#
# ROOT CAUSE (same class as the /api/analysis-jobs fix, proven):
#   AccessControlMiddleware (Security\PlantAccessControl.cs) is deny-by-default
#   by longest-prefix match. /analytics/phase2 (the shipped Phase2 investigation
#   endpoint group: inspection-jobs/save-from-correlation, rule-correlation/run,
#   ml-lifecycle) is NOT in the Matrix. The only entry that prefix-matches it is
#   ("/", GET, anonymous) -> GETs slip through anonymous, POSTs 403 "not mapped".
#   That is why the verify script's rule-correlation POST 403s, and it means the
#   whole Phase2 write surface is currently unreachable for any role.
#
# FIX: one Matrix line ("/analytics/phase2", All(), "analysis.execute", false).
#   analysis.execute is the permission its sibling /analytics/correlations and
#   /analytics/ml routes already use, and which e2eadmin holds. Placed BEFORE the
#   broader ("/analytics/...") entries is unnecessary (longest-prefix wins), but
#   we insert it right after /analytics/ml for readability.
#
# NOT M1-05 code - this is a platform authorization-matrix completeness fix that
#   also unblocks the M1-05 verify script's optional rule-based control step.
#
# Backed up, build-gated, auto-revert. Requires an API RESTART after (static matrix).
# RUN:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Phase2-MatrixFix.ps1
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$SkipBuild)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api'))) {
    Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1
}

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\phase2-matrix-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$MatrixRel  = 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\Security\PlantAccessControl.cs'
$MatrixPath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $MatrixRel
if (-not (Test-Path $MatrixPath)) { Write-Host ('FATAL: missing ' + $MatrixRel) -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

Copy-Item $MatrixPath (Join-Path $BackupDir ($MatrixRel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
Write-Host ('  backup: ' + $MatrixRel) -ForegroundColor DarkGray

function Restore-All {
    $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($MatrixRel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
    if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak $MatrixPath -Force }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backup in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host '=== Phase2 matrix fix ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
Get-Process PlantProcess.Api, dotnet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

try {
    $mx = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($MatrixPath)
    if ($mx.Contains('"/analytics/phase2"')) {
        Write-Host '  matrix already has /analytics/phase2 - skipping.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    else {
        $anchor = '        ("/analytics/ml", new[] { "GET", "POST" }, "analysis.execute", false),'
        if (-not $mx.Contains($anchor)) { throw 'anchor (/analytics/ml) not found - file diverged.' }
        $newLine = $anchor + "`r`n" + '        ("/analytics/phase2", All(), "analysis.execute", false),'
        $mx = $mx.Replace($anchor, $newLine)
        [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($MatrixPath, $mx, $Utf8NoBom)
        Write-Host '  patched: PlantAccessControl.cs (+ /analytics/phase2 -> analysis.execute, all methods)' -ForegroundColor Green
    }
}
catch {
    Write-Host ('FAILED: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

if (-not $SkipBuild) {
    Write-Host '=== Build gate: dotnet build ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    & dotnet build (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\PlantProcess.Api\PlantProcess.Api.csproj') -c Debug --nologo
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'BUILD FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Backend build GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green
}
else { Write-Host 'SkipBuild set.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== Phase2 matrix fix applied ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backup: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host 'RESTART the API for the matrix to load, then the M1-05 verify rule-based step will pass.'
exit 0

[METADATA: Path='Apply-Phase3-BusinessKeyTableCollision.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='PowerShell Script', Lines=206, SizeKB=10.67, SHA256='909CDCC20C602DF174133603AB71340E88D341F4ADC06021C47711EB91A621EF', Modified='2026-07-09 13:01:25']

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Phase3-BusinessKeyTableCollision.ps1
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ROOT CAUSE (proven from the scripts, not inferred from the stack trace)
#
# TWO different tables share ONE name:
#
#   310_mapping_genealogy_foundation.sql:129
#       CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ppiq_business_key_definitions (
#           id, tenant_id NOT NULL, key_code, entity_scope, version_number, created_at_utc)
#       -- a business-key DICTIONARY. ppiq_business_key_members has an FK into it.
#       -- 312 and 313 read d.key_code from it.
#
#   320_p3_business_key_reconciliation.sql:8
#       CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ppiq_business_key_definitions (
#           id, tenant_id NULL, key_type, description, strip_alpha_prefix,
#           strip_leading_zeros, case_insensitive, is_active, created_at_utc)
#       -- a key NORMALIZATION RULE table. Nothing outside 320 uses it.
#
# They share ZERO columns. 310 runs first and creates its table. 320's
# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS then silently does NOTHING, and its very next
# statement inserts key_type ->
#     42703: column "key_type" of relation "ppiq_business_key_definitions"
#            does not exist   (POSITION: 135)
#
# CONSEQUENCE (worse than three red tests):
# EnsurePhase3Sql executes each .sql file as ONE NpgsqlCommand = one implicit
# transaction. The abort at line 21 means NOTHING in 320 is applied:
#     - ppiq_normalize_business_key          (C-0044170 -> 44170)
#     - material_aliases.normalized_alias_code + its index
#     - ppiq_material_alias_conflict_guard   (the AmbiguousJoinKey trigger)
#     - ppiq_resolve_material_by_business_key
# The entire B1.3 / G2 business-key reconciliation feature is missing.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE FIX
#
# Rename 320's table to public.ppiq_business_key_rules. Five references, all
# inside 320. Nothing else in the repo references key_type (verified by grep:
# only 320). 312/313 keep reading 310's key_code untouched.
#
# NO DATA MIGRATION: 320's table has never been created, because its CREATE has
# always been a no-op behind 310's table. There is nothing to move.
# 310's dictionary and the ppiq_business_key_members FK are NOT touched.
#
# WHAT THIS PACK DOES NOT DO
#   - It does not change the tests. If a test also names
#     ppiq_business_key_definitions while expecting the 320 shape, that test is
#     asserting the collision and must be repointed too - the next dotnet test
#     run will say so, and I would rather learn it from a test than guess.
#   - It does not add a migration truth-gate. `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`
#     turned a name collision into a runtime error 200 lines away, and a
#     migration suite that cannot detect two scripts creating one table will do
#     this again. That deserves its own gate, not a line in a hotfix.
#
# Backed up. Idempotent: refuses to run twice.
# RUN: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Phase3-BusinessKeyTableCollision.ps1
#      -WhatIf   shows the exact diff without writing anything
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$WhatIf)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$Script320 = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\database\scripts\320_p3_business_key_reconciliation.sql'
$Script310 = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\database\scripts\310_mapping_genealogy_foundation.sql'

foreach ($p in @($Script320, $Script310)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { Write-Host ('FATAL: missing ' + $p) -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
}

$OldName = 'public.ppiq_business_key_definitions'
$NewName = 'public.ppiq_business_key_rules'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREFLIGHT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '=== preflight ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$text320 = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Script320)
$text310 = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Script310)

if ($text320.Contains($NewName)) {
    Write-Host 'Already applied: 320 already uses ppiq_business_key_rules. Nothing to do.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    exit 0
}

$rx = [regex]::new([regex]::Escape($OldName))
$count = $rx.Matches($text320).Count
Write-Host ('320 references to ' + $OldName + ': ' + $count)
if ($count -ne 5) {
    Write-Host ('ABORT: expected exactly 5 references (CREATE, INSERT, WHERE NOT EXISTS, v_rule, SELECT FROM).') -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ('Found ' + $count + '. The script has drifted; I will not rename blind.') -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# 320 must be the one that wants key_type; 310 must be the one that wants key_code.
if (-not $text320.Contains('key_type')) { Write-Host 'ABORT: 320 does not mention key_type.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
if (-not $text310.Contains('key_code'))  { Write-Host 'ABORT: 310 does not mention key_code.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
if ($text310.Contains('key_type')) {
    Write-Host 'ABORT: 310 mentions key_type - my model of the collision is wrong. Stopping.' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}
# Nothing outside 320 may depend on the 320 shape.
$others = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend') -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.sql', '.cs' } |
    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\bin\\|\\obj\\' } |
    Where-Object { $_.Name -ne '320_p3_business_key_reconciliation.sql' }
$leak = @()
foreach ($f in $others) {
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f.FullName)
    if ($t -match 'ppiq_business_key_definitions' -and $t -match 'key_type') {
        $leak += $f.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)
    }
}
if ($leak.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'WARNING: these files mention BOTH ppiq_business_key_definitions AND key_type:' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($l in $leak) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $l) -ForegroundColor Yellow }
    Write-Host 'They may need repointing to ppiq_business_key_rules as well. Review after this pack.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
Write-Host 'Preflight OK: 5 references, 320 owns key_type, 310 owns key_code.' -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE EDIT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$new = $text320.Replace($OldName, $NewName)

# Header comment: it currently calls this a "dictionary", which is 310's job.
$oldHdr = '-- Business-key dictionary + conflict-rejecting reconciliation (B1.3 / G2).'
$newHdr = '-- Business-key NORMALIZATION RULES + conflict-rejecting reconciliation (B1.3 / G2).' + "`r`n" +
          '-- NOTE: the rules table is ppiq_business_key_rules. It is NOT the business-key' + "`r`n" +
          '-- dictionary created by 310 (ppiq_business_key_definitions, key_code/entity_scope),' + "`r`n" +
          '-- which 312 and 313 read. The two are unrelated; they collided on one name and' + "`r`n" +
          '-- CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS silently hid it until the INSERT below failed.'
if ($new.Contains($oldHdr)) { $new = $new.Replace($oldHdr, $newHdr) }

if ($WhatIf) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '=== -WhatIf: lines that WOULD change ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $before = $text320 -split "`r?`n"
    $after  = $new     -split "`r?`n"
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt [Math]::Max($before.Count, $after.Count); $i++) {
        $b = if ($i -lt $before.Count) { $before[$i] } else { '' }
        $a = if ($i -lt $after.Count)  { $after[$i]  } else { '' }
        if ($b -ne $a) {
            Write-Host ('  - ' + $b) -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host ('  + ' + $a) -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Nothing written (-WhatIf).' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit 0
}

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\phase3-keycollision-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item $Script320 (Join-Path $BackupDir '320_p3_business_key_reconciliation.sql') -Force

$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Script320, $new, $utf8)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SELF-CHECK
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$check = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Script320)
$residual = @()
if ($check.Contains($OldName))                       { $residual += '320 still references ppiq_business_key_definitions' }
if ($rx.Matches($check).Count -ne 0)                 { $residual += 'old-name matches remain' }
if (([regex]::Matches($check, [regex]::Escape($NewName))).Count -ne 5) { $residual += 'expected 5 new-name references' }
if (-not $check.Contains('key_type            text NOT NULL')) { $residual += 'rules table lost its key_type column' }

if ($residual.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'SELF-CHECK FAILED - restoring:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($r in $residual) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $r) -ForegroundColor Red }
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir '320_p3_business_key_reconciliation.sql') $Script320 -Force
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== 320 repointed to public.ppiq_business_key_rules (5 references) ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backup: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'NEXT - in this order:'
Write-Host '  1. Apply the SQL against the app database:'
Write-Host '       .\deploy\scripts\ppiq.ps1 migrate'
Write-Host '  2. Verify the feature actually landed this time:'
Write-Host '       SELECT to_regclass(''public.ppiq_business_key_rules'');            -- not null'
Write-Host '       SELECT public.ppiq_normalize_business_key(''coil'',''C-0044170''); -- expect 44170'
Write-Host '       SELECT to_regprocedure(''public.ppiq_resolve_material_by_business_key(text)'') IS NOT NULL;'
Write-Host '  3. Re-run the three failing tests:'
Write-Host '       dotnet test Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Api.IntegrationTests --filter Phase3GoldenThread'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'IF THE TESTS STILL FAIL: the test file itself may name'
Write-Host 'ppiq_business_key_definitions while expecting the 320 shape. That is the'
Write-Host 'collision asserted in C#, and it repoints the same way. Send me the output.'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'LOGGED, NOT FIXED HERE:'
Write-Host '  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS converted a name collision into a runtime error'
Write-Host '  200 lines away. A migration suite that cannot detect two scripts creating'
Write-Host '  the same table will do this again. That is worth a truth-gate of its own.'
exit 0

[METADATA: Path='Apply-Phase3-SeedGenealogyWeights.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='PowerShell Script', Lines=250, SizeKB=12.63, SHA256='FCF7139526A0B2E4CEF959B352630E78A1881ED57FA99F3B9ABD387E324D485C', Modified='2026-07-09 13:29:50']

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Phase3-SeedGenealogyWeights.ps1
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE DEFECT
#
# P0001: Genealogy contribution weights must sum to 1.0 per child.
#        child=3a000000-...-044170, sum=2.000000
#
# seed\010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql gives the TRANSITION coil C-0044170 three
# parent edges in public.genealogy_edges:
#
#   ed002  slab S-0044170 -> C-0044170   SlabToCoil   1.00   is_transition=false
#   ed003  heat H-3361    -> C-0044170   HeatToCoil   0.70   is_transition=true
#   ed004  heat H-3362    -> C-0044170   HeatToCoil   0.30   is_transition=true
#
# Sum = 2.00. The statement trigger installed by
# 550_v5_p06_blended_provenance.sql (lines 99-108) groups by
# child_material_unit_id ALONE - no relationship_type - and rejects any child
# whose weights deviate from 1.0 by more than 0.015.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE TRIGGER IS RIGHT. THE SEED IS WRONG.
#
# A child's provenance is ONE accounting, not one per lineage level. A transition
# coil is cast across the tail of H-3361 and the head of H-3362: its provenance is
# 70/30 across two heats. Asserting it is ALSO 100% from a slab makes its
# provenance 200% - the slab would itself have to be 70/30, and the coil's
# lineage is double-counted.
#
# THE TWO LAYERS ALREADY MODEL THIS CORRECTLY:
#
#   canonical_genealogy_edges  -> STRUCTURE. No weights, no trigger.
#                                 ppiq_golden_thread / ppiq_walk_genealogy read
#                                 ONLY this layer (321 header says so explicitly).
#                                 The seed's ce0002 gives coil -> slab, so the
#                                 coil -> slab -> heat walk is UNAFFECTED.
#
#   genealogy_edges            -> WEIGHTED PROVENANCE. Trigger-enforced sum = 1.0.
#                                 A transition coil belongs to heats, not slabs.
#
# Structure and attribution are different statements about the same steel. The
# schema knew that. The fixture did not.
#
# VERIFIED AGAINST THE LIVE DATABASE BEFORE WRITING THIS:
#   C-0044170 : 2 edges, sum 1.000000   (HeatToCoil 0.70 + 0.30, both transition)
#   C-0044171 : 1 edge,  sum 1.000000   (HeatToCoil 1.00)
#   S-0044170 : no edges                 -> ed001 will insert fresh at 1.0
#   No SlabToCoil edge exists in real data. ed002 has never applied.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE FIX
#
#   Remove ed002 (slab -> coilT, SlabToCoil, 1.00) from the genealogy_edges seed.
#
#   KEEP ed001 (H-3361 -> S-0044170, HeatToSlab, 1.00)  - slab's parent, sum 1.0
#   KEEP ed003 / ed004                                  - the 0.70/0.30 fixture
#   KEEP ed005 (H-3361 -> C-0044171, HeatToCoil, 1.00)  - normal coil, sum 1.0
#   KEEP ce0002 in the canonical block                  - the walk needs it
#
#   The trigger is NOT touched. Loosening a correct invariant to accommodate an
#   incoherent fixture would be the wrong fix in the most expensive way.
#
# PREFLIGHT computes each seeded child's weight sum using 550's EXACT rule
#   (GROUP BY child_material_unit_id; abs(sum - 1.0) > 0.015)
# against the live database, and refuses to write if the post-fix seed would
# still violate it. Requires psql + PGPASSWORD; -SkipSchemaCheck to bypass.
#
# Backed up. Idempotent. -WhatIf shows the diff.
# RUN: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Phase3-SeedGenealogyWeights.ps1
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$WhatIf,
    [switch]$SkipSchemaCheck,
    [string]$PgHost = '127.0.0.1',
    [string]$PgUser = 'ppiq_dev',
    [string]$PgDb   = 'ppiq_app'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$Seed = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\database\seed\010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql'
if (-not (Test-Path $Seed)) { Write-Host ('FATAL: missing ' + $Seed) -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

Write-Host '=== preflight ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$text = ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Seed)) -replace "`r`n", "`n"

# The offending line, verbatim.
$Ed002 = "        ('3a000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000ed002', now(), true, 'PPIQ_P3_SEED', false, v_slab, v_coilT, 'SlabToCoil', 1.00, false),`n"
$Ed002 = $Ed002 -replace "`r`n", "`n"

if (-not $text.Contains("ed002")) {
    Write-Host 'Already applied: ed002 is not present in the seed. Nothing to do.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    exit 0
}
if (-not $text.Contains($Ed002)) {
    Write-Host 'ABORT: the ed002 line does not match what I expect:' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host ('  ' + $Ed002.Trim()) -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'The seed has drifted. I will not edit it blind.' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# Sanity: the edges we intend to KEEP must all still be there.
$MustKeep = @(
    "'3a000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000ed001'",   # H-3361 -> slab,  HeatToSlab 1.00
    "'3a000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000ed003'",   # H-3361 -> coilT, 0.70 transition
    "'3a000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000ed004'",   # H-3362 -> coilT, 0.30 transition
    "'3a000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000ed005'",   # H-3361 -> coilN, 1.00
    "'3a000000-0000-0000-0000-00000ce0002'"     # canonical slab -> coilT (the WALK)
)
$absent = @($MustKeep | Where-Object { -not $text.Contains($_) })
if ($absent.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'ABORT: edges I intend to keep are missing from the seed:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($a in $absent) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $a) -ForegroundColor Red }
    exit 1
}
Write-Host 'Seed structure matches: ed002 present, 4 keepers + canonical ce0002 present.' -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LIVE CHECK: apply 550's exact rule to the post-fix edge set.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (-not $SkipSchemaCheck) {
    $psql = Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $psql -or -not $env:PGPASSWORD) {
        Write-Host 'WARNING: psql/PGPASSWORD unavailable. Skipping the live weight check.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    else {
        # What the seeded children look like TODAY (ed002 has never applied).
        $q = @"
SELECT mu.material_code || '=' || round(sum(e.contribution_weight),3)
FROM public.genealogy_edges e
JOIN public.material_units mu ON mu.id = e.child_material_unit_id
WHERE COALESCE(e.is_deleted,false)=false
  AND mu.id IN ('3a000000-0000-0000-0000-000000044100',
                '3a000000-0000-0000-0000-000000044170',
                '3a000000-0000-0000-0000-000000044171')
GROUP BY mu.material_code
HAVING abs(sum(e.contribution_weight) - 1.0) > 0.015;
"@
        $bad = & psql -h $PgHost -U $PgUser -d $PgDb -t -A -c $q 2>$null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            Write-Host 'WARNING: could not query the live database. Skipping the check.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
        else {
            $bad = @($bad | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 })
            if ($bad.Count -gt 0) {
                Write-Host 'ABORT: seeded children ALREADY violate the 1.0 invariant in the live DB:' -ForegroundColor Red
                foreach ($b in $bad) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $b) -ForegroundColor Red }
                Write-Host 'Removing ed002 will not be enough. Clear the fixture first:' -ForegroundColor Red
                Write-Host "  DELETE FROM public.genealogy_edges WHERE source_system = 'PPIQ_P3_SEED';" -ForegroundColor Red
                exit 1
            }
            Write-Host 'Live weight check PASSED: every seeded child sums to 1.0 (+/- 0.015).' -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE EDIT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$new = $text.Replace($Ed002, '')

# The comment above the block claims a slab hop; keep the file honest.
$oldNote = "    INSERT INTO public.genealogy_edges"
$newNote = @'
    -- NOTE: the transition coil C-0044170 gets its provenance from HEATS ONLY
    -- (0.70 H-3361 + 0.30 H-3362 = 1.0). It deliberately has NO SlabToCoil edge:
    -- genealogy_edges is a weighted-provenance ledger and 550's trigger enforces
    -- sum(weight) = 1.0 per child, across ALL relationship types. The structural
    -- coil -> slab hop lives in canonical_genealogy_edges (ce0002), which is what
    -- ppiq_walk_genealogy / ppiq_golden_thread actually read.
    INSERT INTO public.genealogy_edges
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n"
if ($new.Contains($oldNote)) { $new = ([regex]::new([regex]::Escape($oldNote))).Replace($new, $newNote, 1) }

if ($WhatIf) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '=== -WhatIf: the genealogy_edges INSERT after the fix ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $i = $new.IndexOf('    -- NOTE: the transition coil')
    if ($i -lt 0) { $i = $new.IndexOf('INSERT INTO public.genealogy_edges') }
    $j = $new.IndexOf('ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;', $i)
    Write-Host $new.Substring($i, $j - $i + 27)
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Nothing written (-WhatIf).' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit 0
}

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\phase3-weights-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item $Seed (Join-Path $BackupDir '010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql') -Force

$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Seed, ($new -replace "`n", "`r`n"), $utf8)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SELF-CHECK
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$check = ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Seed)) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
$residual = @()
# NOTE: do NOT test for the bare word 'SlabToCoil' - the explanatory comment this
# pack inserts contains it ("...has NO SlabToCoil edge"), and an earlier version
# of this check reverted a correct edit by matching its own comment. Test for the
# VALUES ROW, which is the only thing that can actually reach the database.
if ($check.Contains("'SlabToCoil', 1.00, false)"))     { $residual += 'the ed002 VALUES row survived' }
if ($check -match "0000000ed002'")                     { $residual += 'the ed002 uuid survived' }
foreach ($k in $MustKeep) { if (-not $check.Contains($k)) { $residual += ('lost a keeper: ' + $k) } }
if (-not $check.Contains('plant_time_zone_id'))        { $residual += 'the earlier timezone fix was lost' }

if ($residual.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'SELF-CHECK FAILED - restoring:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($r in $residual) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $r) -ForegroundColor Red }
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir '010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql') $Seed -Force
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== seed repaired: ed002 (SlabToCoil 1.00) removed ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backup: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'Every seeded child now sums to exactly 1.0:'
Write-Host '  S-0044170  <- H-3361            1.00'
Write-Host '  C-0044170  <- H-3361 + H-3362   0.70 + 0.30   (transition)'
Write-Host '  C-0044171  <- H-3361            1.00'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'The coil -> slab -> heat WALK is unaffected: it reads'
Write-Host 'canonical_genealogy_edges (ce0002), not genealogy_edges.'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'NEXT:'
Write-Host '  dotnet test Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Api.IntegrationTests --filter Phase3GoldenThread'
Write-Host '  .\deploy\scripts\ppiq.ps1 up          # restore the stack you took down'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'THE FOUR DEFECTS IN THIS ONE FIXTURE CHAIN, for the handover:'
Write-Host '  1. 310/320 collided on ppiq_business_key_definitions; CREATE TABLE IF NOT'
Write-Host '     EXISTS hid it until an INSERT failed 13 lines later.'
Write-Host '  2. 320 takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks unconditionally -> 30s timeout against'
Write-Host '     the test s own connections.'
Write-Host '  3. The seed never learned about plant_time_zone_id / plant_utc_offset_minutes.'
Write-Host '  4. The seed asserted a transition coil is 100% from a slab AND 70/30 from two'
Write-Host '     heats. Provenance = 200%. 550 s trigger was right to refuse it.'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'None of these were product code. ppiq_walk_genealogy, ppiq_golden_thread and'
Write-Host 'blended attribution are live and correct. What was broken is the fixture chain'
Write-Host 'that PROVES them - so the golden thread has been demoed as verified while CI'
Write-Host 'could not actually verify it. That is the finding worth carrying forward.'
exit 0

[METADATA: Path='Apply-Phase3-SeedSchemaDrift.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='PowerShell Script', Lines=230, SizeKB=11.5, SHA256='1EA3F8C348870B7445C4BD30ABCD845C4C83D2667BE4BEEF337B707B2A18AFD8', Modified='2026-07-09 13:21:02']

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Phase3-SeedSchemaDrift.ps1
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE DEFECT
#
# seed\010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql inserts into public.material_units with:
#     id, created_at_utc, is_synthetic, source_system, is_deleted,
#     material_code, material_unit_type, product_family, grade_or_recipe, site_id
#
# But the live table requires TWO more columns that are NOT NULL with no default:
#     plant_time_zone_id        character varying
#     plant_utc_offset_minutes  integer
#
#     -> 23502: null value in column "plant_time_zone_id" of relation
#        "material_units" violates not-null constraint
#
# Every other seed sets them (001_basic_genealogy_seed.sql:118,
# 002_full_feature_demo_seed.sql:577, 003_additional_demo_seed.sql:97,
# 000_..._demo_seed.sql). Only the P3 seed was never updated when the columns
# were added. Schema and fixture drifted apart.
#
# WHY THE SEED AND NOT THE SCHEMA
#   plant_time_zone_id is a first-class domain attribute: MaterialUnit.cs,
#   ProcessEvent.cs, QualityEvent.cs and RiskScore.cs all carry PlantTimeZoneId
#   with validation; RiskScoreService uses it for local-time conversion;
#   StartupConfigurationValidator checks it. The NOT NULL is deliberate. Adding a
#   DEFAULT would weaken a real contract to make one stale fixture compile.
#
# THE VALUES - measured, not chosen:
#     SELECT plant_time_zone_id, plant_utc_offset_minutes, count(*)
#     FROM public.material_units GROUP BY 1,2;
#         Europe/Berlin | 60 | 38345      (one row, no exceptions)
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHY THIS IS THE THIRD DEFECT IN ONE FOUR-FILE CHAIN
#
# EnsurePhase3Sql applies 320, 321, 322 and this seed. We have now found:
#   1. 320 collided with 310 on a table name; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hid it
#      until an INSERT failed 13 lines later.          -> fixed (rules table)
#   2. 320's DDL takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks unconditionally, so it blocked on
#      the test's own connections and timed out at 30s. -> now applies in 3.7s
#   3. THIS: the seed never learned about two NOT NULL columns.
# Each masked the next. The product code was fine throughout; the test fixture
# was not.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREFLIGHT (this is the part that stops the next round trip)
#
# The pack QUERIES THE LIVE DATABASE for every NOT NULL-without-default column on
# material_units and compares it against the seed's column list. If the seed is
# still missing one after the edit, it refuses to write. No more one-column-at-a-
# time discovery.
#
# Requires psql on PATH and PGPASSWORD set, OR pass -SkipSchemaCheck to edit
# blind (not recommended - that is how we got here).
#
# Backed up. Idempotent: refuses to run twice.
# RUN:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Phase3-SeedSchemaDrift.ps1
#       -WhatIf            show the diff, write nothing
#       -SkipSchemaCheck   skip the live-DB verification
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$WhatIf,
    [switch]$SkipSchemaCheck,
    [string]$PgHost = '127.0.0.1',
    [string]$PgUser = 'ppiq_dev',
    [string]$PgDb   = 'ppiq_app'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$Seed = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend\database\seed\010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql'
if (-not (Test-Path $Seed)) { Write-Host ('FATAL: missing ' + $Seed) -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$TimeZone = 'Europe/Berlin'
$Offset   = 60

Write-Host '=== preflight ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Seed)

if ($text.Contains('plant_time_zone_id')) {
    Write-Host 'Already applied: the seed already sets plant_time_zone_id. Nothing to do.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    exit 0
}

# The exact column list and the five VALUES rows, as they stand today.
$OldCols = @'
    INSERT INTO public.material_units
        (id, created_at_utc, is_synthetic, source_system, is_deleted,
         material_code, material_unit_type, product_family, grade_or_recipe, site_id)
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n"

$NewCols = @'
    INSERT INTO public.material_units
        (id, created_at_utc, is_synthetic, source_system, is_deleted,
         material_code, material_unit_type, product_family, grade_or_recipe, site_id,
         plant_time_zone_id, plant_utc_offset_minutes)
'@ -replace "`r`n", "`n"

$normalized = $text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
if (-not $normalized.Contains($OldCols)) {
    Write-Host 'ABORT: the material_units INSERT column list does not match what I expect.' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'The seed has drifted; I will not edit it blind.' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# The five VALUES rows. Each ends with "v_site)," or "v_site)".
$rows = @(
    @{ Old = "'H-3361',    'Heat', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site)"; New = "'H-3361',    'Heat', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site, '$TimeZone', $Offset)" }
    @{ Old = "'H-3362',    'Heat', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site)"; New = "'H-3362',    'Heat', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site, '$TimeZone', $Offset)" }
    @{ Old = "'S-0044170', 'Slab', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site)"; New = "'S-0044170', 'Slab', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site, '$TimeZone', $Offset)" }
    @{ Old = "'C-0044170', 'Coil', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site)"; New = "'C-0044170', 'Coil', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site, '$TimeZone', $Offset)" }
    @{ Old = "'C-0044171', 'Coil', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site)"; New = "'C-0044171', 'Coil', 'FlatSteel', 'S235JR', v_site, '$TimeZone', $Offset)" }
)
foreach ($r in $rows) {
    if (-not $normalized.Contains($r.Old)) {
        Write-Host ('ABORT: VALUES row not found: ' + $r.Old) -ForegroundColor Red
        exit 1
    }
}
Write-Host 'Seed structure matches: 1 column list + 5 VALUES rows.' -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LIVE-SCHEMA CHECK: what does material_units actually demand?
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$suppliedAfterFix = @(
    'id','created_at_utc','is_synthetic','source_system','is_deleted',
    'material_code','material_unit_type','product_family','grade_or_recipe','site_id',
    'plant_time_zone_id','plant_utc_offset_minutes'
)

if (-not $SkipSchemaCheck) {
    $psql = Get-Command psql -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if (-not $psql) {
        Write-Host 'WARNING: psql not on PATH. Skipping the live-schema check.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        Write-Host 'Re-run with psql available, or pass -SkipSchemaCheck to silence this.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    elseif (-not $env:PGPASSWORD) {
        Write-Host 'WARNING: PGPASSWORD not set. Skipping the live-schema check.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    }
    else {
        $q = "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='material_units' AND is_nullable='NO' AND column_default IS NULL ORDER BY ordinal_position;"
        $required = & psql -h $PgHost -U $PgUser -d $PgDb -t -A -c $q 2>$null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $required) {
            Write-Host 'WARNING: could not query the live schema. Skipping the check.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
        }
        else {
            $required = @($required | Where-Object { $_ -and $_.Trim().Length -gt 0 } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() })
            Write-Host ('material_units NOT NULL, no default: ' + ($required -join ', '))
            $missing = @($required | Where-Object { $suppliedAfterFix -notcontains $_ })
            if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
                Write-Host '' -ForegroundColor Red
                Write-Host 'ABORT: after this fix the seed would STILL omit mandatory columns:' -ForegroundColor Red
                foreach ($m in $missing) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $m) -ForegroundColor Red }
                Write-Host 'Tell me their values and I will include them. Not writing.' -ForegroundColor Red
                exit 1
            }
            Write-Host 'Live-schema check PASSED: the fixed seed covers every mandatory column.' -ForegroundColor Green
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE EDIT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$new = $normalized.Replace($OldCols, $NewCols)
foreach ($r in $rows) { $new = $new.Replace($r.Old, $r.New) }

if ($WhatIf) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host '=== -WhatIf: the material_units INSERT after the fix ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $i = $new.IndexOf('INSERT INTO public.material_units')
    $j = $new.IndexOf('ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;', $i)
    Write-Host $new.Substring($i, $j - $i + 27)
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'Nothing written (-WhatIf).' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit 0
}

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\phase3-seeddrift-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item $Seed (Join-Path $BackupDir '010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql') -Force

$out = $new -replace "`n", "`r`n"
$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Seed, $out, $utf8)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SELF-CHECK
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$check = ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Seed)) -replace "`r`n", "`n"
$residual = @()
if (-not $check.Contains('plant_time_zone_id, plant_utc_offset_minutes')) { $residual += 'column list not updated' }
$tzCount = ([regex]::Matches($check, [regex]::Escape("'$TimeZone', $Offset)"))).Count
if ($tzCount -ne 5) { $residual += ("expected 5 VALUES rows with the timezone, found " + $tzCount) }

if ($residual.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'SELF-CHECK FAILED - restoring:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($r in $residual) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $r) -ForegroundColor Red }
    Copy-Item (Join-Path $BackupDir '010_p3_golden_thread_seed.sql') $Seed -Force
    exit 1
}

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== seed repaired: 5 rows now set plant_time_zone_id + plant_utc_offset_minutes ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backup: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'NEXT:'
Write-Host '  dotnet test Backend\tests\PlantProcess.Api.IntegrationTests --filter Phase3GoldenThread'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'The seed is ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING, so if the five fixture rows were'
Write-Host 'somehow already inserted they will NOT be updated. If the tests still fail on'
Write-Host 'missing fixtures, delete them first (they are all source_system = PPIQ_P3_SEED):'
Write-Host "  DELETE FROM public.material_aliases WHERE source_system = 'PPIQ_P3_SEED';"
Write-Host "  DELETE FROM public.genealogy_edges  WHERE source_system = 'PPIQ_P3_SEED';"
Write-Host "  DELETE FROM public.material_units   WHERE source_system = 'PPIQ_P3_SEED';"
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'LOGGED, NOT FIXED HERE (both are truth-gates this repo lacks):'
Write-Host '  1. No CI check that a seed INSERT covers every NOT NULL-without-default'
Write-Host '     column of its table. That single check would have caught this before it'
Write-Host '     was ever committed - and it is a five-line query.'
Write-Host '  2. No CI check that two numbered scripts never CREATE the same table.'
Write-Host '     CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS silently hid the 310/320 collision for weeks.'
exit 0

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Implements the PlantProcess IQ public-collateral closure package:
      - Real public website lead delivery to a configured inbox.
      - A reproducible 2–3 minute demo-video production pipeline.
      - A sharpened PlantProcess IQ flagship page with honest coming-soon stubs.

.DESCRIPTION
    This installer is idempotent and purpose-named. It:
      1. Creates a dedicated anonymous, rate-limited public lead-capture endpoint.
      2. Persists every lead, sends a real SMTP email, records delivery state,
         and returns UI success only after SMTP accepts the message.
      3. Replaces the website form with a same-origin production-safe client.
      4. Rebuilds the public product presentation around one strong PPIQ page.
      5. Marks MES, QES, Yard and Energy honestly as coming soon.
      6. Adds static honesty checks and Playwright tests for desktop/tablet/mobile.
      7. Installs an FFmpeg-based video builder and optionally renders the final MP4.
      8. Generates an evidence folder with logs, hashes and acceptance results.

    No SMTP password is written into the repository. Development secrets are stored
    through `dotnet user-secrets`; production values are supplied as environment
    variables in the server's gitignored deployment environment.

.EXAMPLE
    # Apply code and configure Gmail/Google Workspace SMTP in .NET user-secrets.
    $smtpPassword = Read-Host 'SMTP app password' -AsSecureString
    .\Apply-PPIQ-Public-Collateral.ps1 `
      -LeadInboxAddress 'you@yourdomain.com' `
      -SmtpHost 'smtp.gmail.com' `
      -SmtpPort 587 `
      -SmtpUser 'you@yourdomain.com' `
      -SmtpPassword $smtpPassword `
      -SmtpFromAddress 'you@yourdomain.com' `
      -RunBuildValidation

.EXAMPLE
    # Also render the final 2–3 minute video. When VideoPlanPath is omitted,
    # the script asks interactively for segment timestamps.
    .\Apply-PPIQ-Public-Collateral.ps1 `
      -LeadInboxAddress 'you@yourdomain.com' `
      -SmtpHost 'smtp.gmail.com' `
      -SmtpUser 'you@yourdomain.com' `
      -SmtpPassword (Read-Host 'SMTP app password' -AsSecureString) `
      -DryRunVideo 'C:\Recordings\PPIQ-dry-run.mp4' `
      -RunBuildValidation

.NOTES
    Target repository: C:\Workspace\PlantProcess-IQ
    Supported shell: Windows PowerShell 5.1+ and PowerShell 7+
#>

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

function Write-Stage {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message)
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host ('=' * 88) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    Write-Host $Message -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Write-Host ('=' * 88) -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}

function Write-Ok {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[GREEN] $Message" -ForegroundColor Green
}

function Write-Warn {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Message)
    $script:Warnings.Add($Message) | Out-Null
    Write-Host "[YELLOW] $Message" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Assert-Path {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter()][ValidateSet('Leaf','Container')][string]$Type = 'Leaf'
    )

    if ($Type -eq 'Leaf' -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Required file not found: $Path"
    }

    if ($Type -eq 'Container' -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Container)) {
        throw "Required directory not found: $Path"
    }
}

function Ensure-Directory {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Container)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Path -Force | Out-Null
    }
}

function Backup-Path {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path -PathType Leaf)) {
        return
    }

    $relative = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path).Substring([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($RepoRoot).Length).TrimStart('\','/')
    $destination = Join-Path $script:BackupRoot $relative
    Ensure-Directory (Split-Path -Parent $destination)
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Path -Destination $destination -Force
}

function Write-TextFile {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][AllowEmptyString()][string]$Content
    )

    Ensure-Directory (Split-Path -Parent $Path)
    Backup-Path $Path

    $normalized = $Content -replace "`r?`n", "`r`n"
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $normalized, $script:Utf8NoBom)
    $script:Changes.Add($Path) | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Wrote $Path"
}

function Add-TextIfMissing {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Text,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Identity
    )

    Assert-Path $Path
    $current = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
    if ($current.Contains($Identity)) {
        return
    }

    Backup-Path $Path
    $updated = $current.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + $Text.Trim() + "`r`n"
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $updated, $script:Utf8NoBom)
    $script:Changes.Add($Path) | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Updated $Path"
}

function Replace-ExactlyOnce {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Search,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Replacement,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$AlreadyAppliedMarker
    )

    Assert-Path $Path
    $content = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)

    if ($content.Contains($AlreadyAppliedMarker)) {
        Write-Ok "Already patched: $Path"
        return
    }

    $first = $content.IndexOf($Search, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($first -lt 0) {
        throw "Patch anchor not found in $Path. Expected: $Search"
    }

    $second = $content.IndexOf($Search, $first + $Search.Length, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if ($second -ge 0) {
        throw "Patch anchor occurred more than once in $Path; refusing an ambiguous edit."
    }

    Backup-Path $Path
    $updated = $content.Substring(0, $first) + $Replacement + $content.Substring($first + $Search.Length)
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $updated, $script:Utf8NoBom)
    $script:Changes.Add($Path) | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Patched $Path"
}

function Invoke-Logged {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Name,
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][scriptblock]$Action,
        [switch]$AllowFailure
    )

    Ensure-Directory $script:LogsRoot
    $safeName = ($Name -replace '[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]', '_')
    $logPath = Join-Path $script:LogsRoot "$safeName.log"

    Write-Host "[RUN] $Name" -ForegroundColor DarkCyan
    try {
        & $Action 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $logPath
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $null -ne $LASTEXITCODE) {
            throw "$Name exited with code $LASTEXITCODE"
        }
        Write-Ok "$Name completed"
    }
    catch {
        if ($AllowFailure) {
            Write-Warn "$Name failed: $($_.Exception.Message). See $logPath"
            return $false
        }
        throw
    }
    return $true
}

function ConvertFrom-SecureStringPlainText {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][Security.SecureString]$SecureValue)

    $ptr = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($SecureValue)
    try {
        return [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($ptr)
    }
    finally {
        [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($ptr)
    }
}

function Test-EmailAddress {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Value)
    try {
        $mail = New-Object Net.Mail.MailAddress($Value)
        return $mail.Address -eq $Value.Trim()
    }
    catch {
        return $false
    }
}

function Wait-HttpReady {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Url,
        [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 120
    )

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($TimeoutSeconds)
    do {
        try {
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
            if ($response.StatusCode -ge 200 -and $response.StatusCode -lt 500) {
                return $true
            }
        }
        catch {
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
        }
    } while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline)

    return $false
}

function Update-PackageScripts {
    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Path)

    Assert-Path $Path
    Backup-Path $Path
    $package = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Path -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

    $scripts = [ordered]@{}
    foreach ($property in $package.scripts.PSObject.Properties) {
        $scripts[$property.Name] = [string]$property.Value
    }

    $scripts['validate:public-site'] = 'node scripts/validate-public-site.mjs'
    $scripts['test:public-site'] = 'playwright test --config playwright.public-site.config.ts'
    $scripts['acceptance:public-site'] = 'npm run build && npm run validate:public-site && npm run test:public-site && npm run phase10:guard'

    $package.scripts = [pscustomobject]$scripts
    $json = $package | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 32
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, ($json -replace "`n", "`r`n") + "`r`n", $script:Utf8NoBom)
    $script:Changes.Add($Path) | Out-Null
    Write-Ok "Updated website package scripts"
}

function Configure-LeadCaptureUserSecrets {
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($LeadInboxAddress) -and [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SmtpHost)) {
        Write-Warn 'SMTP settings were not supplied. Code will be installed, but real inbox delivery remains disabled until configuration is provided.'
        return
    }

    if (-not (Test-EmailAddress $LeadInboxAddress)) {
        throw "LeadInboxAddress is not a valid email address: $LeadInboxAddress"
    }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SmtpHost)) {
        throw 'SmtpHost is required when LeadInboxAddress is provided.'
    }
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SmtpFromAddress)) {
        if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SmtpUser) -and (Test-EmailAddress $SmtpUser)) {
            $script:SmtpFromAddress = $SmtpUser
        }
        else {
            throw 'SmtpFromAddress is required when SmtpUser is empty or not an email address.'
        }
    }
    if (-not (Test-EmailAddress $script:SmtpFromAddress)) {
        throw "SmtpFromAddress is not a valid email address: $($script:SmtpFromAddress)"
    }

    if ($null -eq $SmtpPassword -and -not $NonInteractive -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($SmtpUser)) {
        $script:SmtpPassword = Read-Host 'Enter the SMTP password/app-password (stored only in .NET user-secrets)' -AsSecureString
    }

    $plainPassword = ''
    if ($null -ne $script:SmtpPassword) {
        $plainPassword = ConvertFrom-SecureStringPlainText $script:SmtpPassword
    }

    $pairs = [ordered]@{
        'PublicLeadCapture:Enabled' = 'true'
        'PublicLeadCapture:TenantId' = $PublicTenantId
        'PublicLeadCapture:InboxAddress' = $LeadInboxAddress
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpHost' = $SmtpHost
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpPort' = [string]$SmtpPort
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpUsername' = $SmtpUser
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpPassword' = $plainPassword
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpFromAddress' = $script:SmtpFromAddress
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpFromName' = $SmtpFromName
        'PublicLeadCapture:SmtpEnableSsl' = $SmtpEnableSsl.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()
        'PublicLeadCapture:RequireEmailDelivery' = 'true'
        'PublicLeadCapture:MinimumHumanSubmitSeconds' = '2'
    }

    foreach ($pair in $pairs.GetEnumerator()) {
        $key = [string]$pair.Key
        $value = [string]$pair.Value
        & dotnet user-secrets set $key $value --project $ApiProjectPath | Out-Null
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "dotnet user-secrets failed while setting $key"
        }
    }

    $plainPassword = $null
    Write-Ok 'Stored local lead-delivery configuration in .NET user-secrets.'
}
