[METADATA: Path='Apply-Step1-MojibakeRepair.ps1', Category='Tools, Validation Scripts, Root Config, Docs, Misc', Classification='PowerShell Script', Lines=342, SizeKB=15.03, SHA256='82A39DE2E70C61B2C07AE3F968E57D1C2620E7558BE81C98BCF3623F6C16EA27', Modified='2026-07-09 10:48:11']

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Step1-MojibakeRepair.ps1
# STEP 1 of the 8-page professionalisation plan (Karim, 09-Jul-2026).
#
# WHAT IS BROKEN
#   Source files contain UTF-8 text that was at some point decoded as Windows-1252
#   and re-saved as UTF-8 ("mojibake"). Visible symptoms in the running HMI:
#       "Pack G <A-circumflex><middot> T-096"  should read  "Pack G <middot> T-096"
#       "720 <a-circ><dagger><arrow-junk> 760 degC"  should read  "720 <right-arrow> 760 degC"
#       "Expected <a-circ><sub-junk> impact"  should read  "Expected <euro-sign> impact"
#   Some comment banners were re-encoded MANY times (one is 3,315 chars of
#   long runs of A-tilde/dagger junk where box-drawing rules used to be).
#
# HOW IT IS FIXED (proven against the real corrupted strings before writing this)
#   Repair = encode the text back to Windows-1252, then decode it as UTF-8.
#   Repeat until no mojibake markers remain (multi-level damage needs 2-3 passes).
#   Each pass is guarded: if a character cannot be mapped to cp1252, or the bytes
#   are not valid UTF-8, the pass is REFUSED and the line is left alone. Nothing
#   is guessed.
#
#   MEASURED ON THE 08-Jul SNAPSHOT (frontend):
#     129 corrupted lines
#     116 round-trip perfectly clean
#      13 are LOSSY - the original character was destroyed by repeated encoding
#         and ALL 13 are decorative comment separators. ZERO lossy lines in code,
#         JSX, or any user-visible string.
#
#   Therefore:
#     * repairable lines  -> round-tripped exactly
#     * lossy COMMENT lines -> the dead run is replaced with a clean ASCII banner
#                              ("// --- Navigation definition ---"); the readable
#                              words are preserved, the garbage is not
#     * lossy NON-comment lines -> NEVER auto-edited. Reported for your decision.
#       (There are none today; the guard exists so a future one cannot slip past.)
#
# ALSO ADDS: src/test/architecture/noMojibake.test.ts
#   A regression gate so this class of corruption cannot come back silently.
#
# SCOPE: Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src  (*.ts, *.tsx, *.css)
#        Backend is SCANNED and REPORTED but not modified (say the word and I
#        will extend it; C# string literals deserve their own review).
#        Excluded: node_modules, dist, _phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup.
#
# Backed up, tsc + architecture-suite gated, auto-revert on failure.
# RUN:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Step1-MojibakeRepair.ps1
#       Add -ReportOnly to see the damage report without changing a single file.
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$ReportOnly,
    [switch]$SkipFrontend
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRoot  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web'
$SrcRoot  = Join-Path $WebRoot 'src'
if (-not (Test-Path $SrcRoot)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\step1-mojibake-" + $Stamp)
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$Cp1252    = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(1252)

# Strict UTF-8: throws on invalid byte sequences instead of inserting U+FFFD.
$Utf8Strict = [System.Text.Encoding]::GetEncoding(
    'utf-8',
    (New-Object System.Text.EncoderExceptionFallback),
    (New-Object System.Text.DecoderExceptionFallback))

# Mojibake markers. Deliberately broad: an under-reporting detector is worse than none.
#   U+00C3 or U+00C2 followed by any Latin-1 / punctuation / Latin-Ext char, OR
#   U+00E2 followed by any non-ASCII (catches the e-circumflex bigrams)
$MarkerRegex = [regex] '[\u00C3\u00C2][\u0080-\u00FF\u2000-\u20FF\u0152-\u0178]|\u00E2[\u0080-\u30FF]'

$GateRel = 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src\test\architecture\noMojibake.test.ts'

function Test-Mojibake { param([string]$Text) return $MarkerRegex.IsMatch($Text) }

# One repair pass: cp1252-encode, utf8-decode. Returns $null if the pass is unsafe.
function Invoke-RepairPass {
    param([string]$Text)
    try {
        $bytes = $Cp1252.GetBytes($Text)
        # Guard: .NET substitutes '?' for unmappable chars. If the round-trip back
        # through cp1252 is not identical, a character was lost -> refuse the pass.
        if ($Cp1252.GetString($bytes) -ne $Text) { return $null }
        return $Utf8Strict.GetString($bytes)
    }
    catch { return $null }
}

function Repair-Line {
    param([string]$Line)
    $cur = $Line
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 15; $i++) {
        if (-not (Test-Mojibake $cur)) { break }
        $next = Invoke-RepairPass $cur
        if ($null -eq $next -or $next -eq $cur) { break }
        $cur = $next
    }
    return $cur
}

function Test-IsComment {
    param([string]$Line)
    $t = $Line.TrimStart()
    return ($t.StartsWith('//') -or $t.StartsWith('*') -or $t.StartsWith('/*'))
}

# For lossy comment banners: keep the readable ASCII words, drop the garbage.
function Normalize-DeadComment {
    param([string]$Line)
    $indent = ''
    if ($Line -match '^(\s*)') { $indent = $Matches[1] }
    $ascii = ($Line -replace '[^\x20-\x7E]', ' ')
    $ascii = $ascii -replace '^\s*(//+|\*/?|/\*)\s*', ''
    $ascii = ($ascii -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ascii)) { return ($indent + '// ---') }
    return ($indent + '// --- ' + $ascii + ' ---')
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. SCAN
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '=== STEP 1: mojibake scan ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

# NOTE: -Include with -Path only works when the path ends in \*, otherwise it
# silently returns nothing. Filter on Extension instead - a false "clean" scan
# would be the worst possible failure mode for this pack.
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcRoot -Recurse -File |
    Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.ts', '.tsx', '.css' } |
    Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\node_modules\\|\\dist\\|_phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup' }
if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'FATAL: scanned 0 files - path/filter wrong, refusing to report a false clean.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
Write-Host ('scanned files: ' + $files.Count)

$report          = @()
$totalDirty      = 0
$totalRepairable = 0
$lossyComments   = 0
$lossyCode       = @()

foreach ($file in $files) {
    $text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file.FullName)
    if (-not (Test-Mojibake $text)) { continue }

    $lines = $text -split "`r?`n"
    $dirty = 0; $fixable = 0; $lossyC = 0
    foreach ($line in $lines) {
        if (-not (Test-Mojibake $line)) { continue }
        $dirty++
        $fixed = Repair-Line $line
        if (-not (Test-Mojibake $fixed)) { $fixable++ }
        elseif (Test-IsComment $line)    { $lossyC++ }
        else { $lossyCode += ($file.Name + ': ' + $line.Trim().Substring(0, [Math]::Min(70, $line.Trim().Length))) }
    }
    $totalDirty      += $dirty
    $totalRepairable += $fixable
    $lossyComments   += $lossyC
    $report += [pscustomobject]@{
        File         = $file.FullName.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)
        Dirty        = $dirty
        Repairable   = $fixable
        DeadComments = $lossyC
    }
}

if ($report.Count -eq 0) {
    Write-Host 'No mojibake found in Frontend\PlantProcess.Web\src. Nothing to do.' -ForegroundColor Green
}
else {
    $report | Sort-Object -Property Dirty -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
    Write-Host ('TOTAL dirty lines : ' + $totalDirty)
    Write-Host ('  round-trip clean: ' + $totalRepairable) -ForegroundColor Green
    Write-Host ('  dead comments   : ' + $lossyComments + '  (rewritten as ASCII banners)') -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Write-Host ('  lossy CODE lines: ' + $lossyCode.Count) -ForegroundColor $(if ($lossyCode.Count -gt 0) { 'Red' } else { 'Green' })
    foreach ($l in $lossyCode) { Write-Host ('     !! ' + $l) -ForegroundColor Red }
}

# Backend: scan + report only.
$backendRoot = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Backend'
if (Test-Path $backendRoot) {
    $beDirty = 0
    Get-ChildItem -Path $backendRoot -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Extension -eq '.cs' } |
        Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\bin\\|\\obj\\' } | ForEach-Object {
            $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($_.FullName)
            if (Test-Mojibake $t) { $beDirty++ }
        }
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host ('BACKEND (.cs) files containing mojibake: ' + $beDirty + '  [scanned, NOT modified]') -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

if ($ReportOnly) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'ReportOnly - no files were changed.' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit 0
}
if ($report.Count -eq 0) { exit 0 }

if ($lossyCode.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host ''
    Write-Host 'ABORTING: lossy mojibake found in NON-comment lines (listed above).' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'These are user-visible strings whose original characters cannot be recovered' -ForegroundColor Red
    Write-Host 'automatically. Tell me what they should read and I will fix them explicitly.' -ForegroundColor Red
    exit 1
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. REPAIR
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== repairing ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan

$changedFiles = @()
foreach ($row in $report) {
    $full = Join-Path $RepoRoot $row.File
    Copy-Item $full (Join-Path $BackupDir ($row.File -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force

    $text  = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($full)
    $hadCrLf = $text.Contains("`r`n")
    $lines = $text -split "`r?`n"

    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) {
        if (-not (Test-Mojibake $lines[$i])) { continue }
        $fixed = Repair-Line $lines[$i]
        if (Test-Mojibake $fixed) {
            if (Test-IsComment $lines[$i]) { $fixed = Normalize-DeadComment $lines[$i] }
            else { throw ('unexpected lossy code line in ' + $row.File) }
        }
        $lines[$i] = $fixed
    }

    $joiner = if ($hadCrLf) { "`r`n" } else { "`n" }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($full, ($lines -join $joiner), $Utf8NoBom)
    $changedFiles += $row.File
    Write-Host ('  repaired: ' + $row.File + '  (' + $row.Dirty + ' lines)') -ForegroundColor Green
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Regression gate
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
$GateContent = @'
// ============================================================
// Encoding regression gate (Step 1, 09-Jul-2026).
// Source files must never again contain UTF-8-decoded-as-Windows-1252 text
// ("mojibake"), e.g. a stray A-circumflex before a middot in "Pack G . T-096".
// Root cause when this fires: a file was read as cp1252 and re-saved as UTF-8.
// Fix by re-saving as UTF-8 (no BOM), not by deleting the characters.
// ============================================================
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve, join } from "node:path";

const srcRoot = resolve(__dirname, "../..");
const EXCLUDE = /node_modules|dist|_phase9_standardbutton_dedupe_backup/;
const MOJIBAKE = /[\u00C3\u00C2][\u0080-\u00FF\u2000-\u20FF\u0152-\u0178]|\u00E2[\u0080-\u30FF]/;

function walk(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir)) {
    const full = join(dir, entry);
    if (EXCLUDE.test(full)) continue;
    if (statSync(full).isDirectory()) walk(full, out);
    else if (/\.(ts|tsx|css)$/.test(entry)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

describe("encoding: no mojibake in source", () => {
  it("no source file contains UTF-8-as-cp1252 corruption", () => {
    const offenders: string[] = [];
    for (const file of walk(srcRoot)) {
      const lines = readFileSync(file, "utf8").split(/\r?\n/);
      lines.forEach((line, i) => {
        if (MOJIBAKE.test(line)) {
          offenders.push(`${file.replace(srcRoot, "src")}:${i + 1}: ${line.trim().slice(0, 60)}`);
        }
      });
    }
    expect(offenders, `Mojibake found:\n  ${offenders.join("\n  ")}`).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});
'@

$gatePath = Join-Path $RepoRoot $GateRel
$gateDir  = Split-Path -Parent $gatePath
if (-not (Test-Path $gateDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $gateDir -Force | Out-Null }
$gateNorm = ($GateContent -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($gatePath, $gateNorm, $Utf8NoBom)
Write-Host '  created: src/test/architecture/noMojibake.test.ts (regression gate)' -ForegroundColor Green

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $changedFiles) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak (Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel) -Force }
    }
    if (Test-Path $gatePath) { Remove-Item $gatePath -Force }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Gates
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (-not $SkipFrontend) {
    Write-Host '=== Build gate: tsc -b ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $WebRoot
    & cmd /c "npx tsc -b"
    $tscExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($tscExit -ne 0) { Write-Host 'tsc FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'tsc GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host '=== FULL architecture suite (incl. new mojibake gate) ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $WebRoot
    & cmd /c "npx vitest run src/test/architecture/"
    $gateExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($gateExit -ne 0) { Write-Host 'GATES FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Architecture gates GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green
}
else { Write-Host 'SkipFrontend set - run tsc + vitest before committing.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== STEP 1 COMPLETE: encoding repaired ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backups: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ('Files repaired: ' + $changedFiles.Count)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'RENDER CHECK: the What-if page should now read'
Write-Host '  "Pack G . T-096"     -> proper middot'
Write-Host '  "720 -> 760 degC"    -> proper arrow'
Write-Host '  "Expected EUR impact"-> proper euro sign'
Write-Host '(The Pack/T-id text itself is removed in STEP 2.)'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'COMMIT:'
Write-Host '  git add Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src'
Write-Host '  git commit -m "Step 1: repair UTF-8-as-cp1252 mojibake across frontend source; add noMojibake regression gate"'
exit 0

[FILE_END]

#      residual literal "Phase 15 " in strings -> removed

# D. DEMO MACHINERY - only the changes that are PURE RENAMES / DEFAULTS.

#                     result line reworded to state the privacy threshold plainly

#                     -> EMPTY fields (placeholders belong on the input, added in Step 3)

#      * "Reload demo request" + valueRealizationDemoRequest()
#        + recommendationDemoRequest()  -- these FETCH THE PAGE'S ONLY DATA.
#        Deleting the button leaves the page blank. Honest fix = relabel
#        "Load sample request" + a visible "Sample data" badge, done in Step 3.
#      * "demo-approver" hardcoded approver identity -> must become the logged-in
#        user. That needs useAuth wiring inside RecommendationsPage; Step 3.
#      * Dropping the "Mode" stat card from all 8 grids -> Step 3 (StandardStatGrid).
#
# E. GATE: extends src\test\architecture\noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath.test.ts with
#      PAGE-CONTENT assertions, scoped to the 8 pages:
#        - no <h1> contains "Phase <n>"
#        - no data-testid contains a phase token
#        - no "Pack <A-G> ... T-<nnn>" kicker survives
#        - no file lives under a src/pages/PhaseNN directory
#      Scoped to the 8 pages ON PURPOSE: /license (h1 "Phase 10 License Runtime
#      Demo") and /access-matrix ("Role matrix for demo and buyer review") are
#      reachable pages you have not yet ruled on. Widening the gate before that
#      decision would make it fail on work that was never authorised.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# APPROVED TITLES / SUBTITLES (from PPIQ_8Page_Copy_Draft_09Jul2026.md)
#   Honesty Certification -> "Advisory Honesty Certification"
#   Benchmarking          -> "Cross-Plant Benchmarking"
#   ROI/CFO               -> "Value & Payback"

#   Recommendations       -> "Advisory Recommendations"
#   Scenario Simulation   -> "What-If Scenario Analysis"
#   Edge Collector        -> "Edge Collector Management"   (unchanged, kicker removed)
#   Historian Connector   -> "Historian Connector"         (unchanged, kicker removed)
#
# PREFLIGHT: every anchor is verified BEFORE any file is written. One missing
# anchor aborts the whole pack with zero changes - no half-applied rename across
# eight pages.
#
# Backed up, tsc + full architecture suite gated, auto-revert on failure.
# RUN: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Step2-DeepDephase.ps1
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$SkipFrontend)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRoot  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web'
$SrcRoot  = Join-Path $WebRoot 'src'
if (-not (Test-Path $SrcRoot)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\step2-dephase-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$Phase15Dir  = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'pages\Phase15'
$AdvisoryDir = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'pages\Advisory'
$ApiOld      = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'api\phase15Advisory.ts'

if (Test-Path $AdvisoryDir) { Write-Host 'FATAL: src\pages\Advisory already exists.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$Pages = @(
    @{ File='HonestyCertificationPage.tsx'; H1Old='<h1>Phase 15 Honesty Certification</h1>';        H1New='<h1>Advisory Honesty Certification</h1>';
       Sub='Independent verification that advisory output never overstates what the evidence supports.';

       Sub='Potential value, realised value and payback, each traceable to its ledger entry.';
       TidOld='phase15-roi-cfo-dashboard-page'; TidNew='roi-cfo-dashboard-page' }
    @{ File='ValueRealizationPage.tsx';     H1Old='<h1>Phase 15 Value Realization</h1>';             H1New='<h1>Value Realisation Tracking</h1>';
       Sub='Measured KPI movement after a recommendation was acted on, against a reproducible baseline.';
       TidOld='phase15-value-realization-page'; TidNew='value-realization-page' }
    @{ File='RecommendationsPage.tsx';      H1Old='<h1>Phase 15 Recommendations</h1>';               H1New='<h1>Advisory Recommendations</h1>';
       Sub='Guarded suggestions with expected impact, evidence, and a required human approval step.';
       TidOld='phase15-recommendations-page'; TidNew='recommendations-page' }
    @{ File='ScenarioSimulationPage.tsx';   H1Old='<h1>Phase 15 What-if Scenario Simulation</h1>';   H1New='<h1>What-If Scenario Analysis</h1>';
       Sub='Projected outcomes for process changes inside the observed operating envelope.';
       TidOld='phase15-scenario-page'; TidNew='scenario-simulation-page' }
)

# Kicker lines ("Pack G . T-101 . ...") sit alone on a line. Match by regex so the
# pack itself stays pure ASCII (the separator is a non-ASCII middot).
$KickerRegex = [regex]::new('^(\s*)Pack\s+[A-G].*T-\d+.*$', [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Multiline)

# File-header comments like "// Pack G . T-096 . What-if scenario simulation engine".
# The kicker regex deliberately does not match these (they start with //), but the
# gate does - and Karim's instruction was explicit that headers must be fixed too.
$CommentRegex = [regex]::new('^\s*//\s*Pack\s+[A-G].*T-\d+.*$', [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Multiline)

function Get-PlainTitle {
    param([string]$H1)
    $t = $H1 -replace '</?h1>', ''
    return ($t.Replace('&amp;', '&'))
}

# Literal demo strings that are safe pure renames.
$DemoRenames = @(
    @{ File='BenchmarkingPage.tsx';       Old='>Demo suppressed benchmark<'; New='>Preview suppression behaviour<' }
    @{ File='BenchmarkingPage.tsx';       Old='"Suppressed benchmark demo loaded. Below-minimum cohort does not expose aggregate bands."';
                                          New='"This cohort is below the minimum privacy threshold, so no aggregate band is shown."' }
    @{ File='ScenarioSimulationPage.tsx'; Old='>Demo out-of-envelope abstain<'; New='>Test an out-of-envelope value<' }
    @{ File='ScenarioSimulationPage.tsx'; Old='"Out-of-envelope demo prepared. Run simulation to confirm abstain/insufficient support behavior."';
                                          New='"Out-of-envelope value prepared. Run the simulation to confirm the engine abstains."' }
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREFLIGHT - verify every anchor before touching anything

Write-Host '=== STEP 2 preflight: verifying every anchor ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$missing = @()

foreach ($pg in $Pages) {

    if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { $missing += ('missing file ' + $pg.File); continue }
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    if (-not $t.Contains($pg.H1Old))              { $missing += ($pg.File + ' :: h1 anchor [' + $pg.H1Old + ']') }
    if (-not $t.Contains($pg.TidOld))             { $missing += ($pg.File + ' :: testid [' + $pg.TidOld + ']') }
    if (-not $KickerRegex.IsMatch($t))            { $missing += ($pg.File + ' :: kicker line') }
}
foreach ($d in $DemoRenames) {
    $f = Join-Path $Phase15Dir $d.File
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    if (-not $t.Contains($d.Old)) { $missing += ($d.File + ' :: demo string [' + $d.Old.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(45, $d.Old.Length)) + '...]') }
}

foreach ($pg in $Pages) {
    $stem = $pg.File -replace '\.tsx$', ''
    if (-not $appText.Contains('./pages/Phase15/' + $stem)) { $missing += ('App.tsx :: import ./pages/Phase15/' + $stem) }
}

$edgeText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($EdgePage)
foreach ($a in @('useState("edge-demo-collector-01")', 'useState("Demo OT-safe Edge Collector 01")')) {
    if (-not $edgeText.Contains($a)) { $missing += ('EdgeCollectorPage :: ' + $a) }
}
$histText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($HistPage)
foreach ($a in @('useState("opc.tcp://demo-historian-gateway:4840")', 'useState("urn:plantprocessiq:demo:historian")')) {
    if (-not $histText.Contains($a)) { $missing += ('HistorianConnectorPage :: ' + $a) }
}

$apiText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($ApiOld)

if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'PREFLIGHT FAILED - nothing was changed. Missing anchors:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($m in $missing) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $m) -ForegroundColor Red }
    exit 1
}
Write-Host ('All anchors present (' + $Pages.Count + ' pages, ' + $DemoRenames.Count + ' demo strings).') -ForegroundColor Green

$BackupList = @()
function Backup-File {
    param([string]$Full)
    $rel = $Full.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)
    Copy-Item $Full (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    $script:BackupList += $rel
}
Get-ChildItem $Phase15Dir -File | ForEach-Object { Backup-File $_.FullName }
Backup-File $ApiOld; Backup-File $AppTsx; Backup-File $EdgePage; Backup-File $HistPage; Backup-File $GatePath

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (Test-Path $AdvisoryDir) { Remove-Item $AdvisoryDir -Recurse -Force }
    if (-not (Test-Path $Phase15Dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Phase15Dir -Force | Out-Null }
    if (Test-Path $ApiNew) { Remove-Item $ApiNew -Force }
    foreach ($rel in $BackupList) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        $dst = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
        $dir = Split-Path -Parent $dst
        if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak $dst -Force }
    }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

function Save-Text { param([string]$Path, [string]$Text) [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $Utf8NoBom) }

try {
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A. Move Phase15 -> Advisory
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $AdvisoryDir -Force | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem $Phase15Dir -File | ForEach-Object { Move-Item $_.FullName (Join-Path $AdvisoryDir $_.Name) -Force }
    Remove-Item $Phase15Dir -Recurse -Force
    Write-Host '  moved: src\pages\Phase15 -> src\pages\Advisory' -ForegroundColor Green

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # B. API file + symbols
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $api = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($ApiOld)
    $api = $api -replace '\bP15(?=[A-Z])', ''
    $api = $api.Replace('phase15AdvisoryApi', 'advisoryApi')
    $api = $api.Replace('benchmarkingSuppressedDemo', 'benchmarkingSuppressionPreview')
    $hdr = "// ============================================================`r`n" +
           "// FILE: src/api/advisoryApi.ts`r`n" +
           "// Step 2: renamed from phase15Advisory.ts (Naming Golden Rule).`r`n" +
           "// Backend endpoint URLs are server routes and are intentionally unchanged.`r`n" +
           "// ============================================================`r`n"
    Save-Text $ApiNew ($hdr + $api)
    Remove-Item $ApiOld -Force
    Write-Host '  renamed: api/phase15Advisory.ts -> api/advisoryApi.ts (+ 47 P15* types stripped)' -ForegroundColor Green

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # C + D. Page content
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    foreach ($pg in $Pages) {
        $f = Join-Path $AdvisoryDir $pg.File
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)

        # file-header comment -> plain descriptive comment
        $t = $CommentRegex.Replace($t, ('// ' + (Get-PlainTitle $pg.H1New)))

        # kicker -> subtitle (preserve indentation)
        $t = $KickerRegex.Replace($t, ('${1}' + $pg.Sub), 1)

        $t = $t.Replace($pg.H1Old, $pg.H1New)
        $t = $t.Replace($pg.TidOld, $pg.TidNew)

        # imports + symbols
        $t = $t.Replace('@/api/phase15Advisory', '@/api/advisoryApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('phase15AdvisoryApi', 'advisoryApi')
        $t = $t.Replace('benchmarkingSuppressedDemo', 'benchmarkingSuppressionPreview')
        $t = $t -replace '\bP15(?=[A-Z])', ''

        # residual phase wording in status strings
        $t = $t.Replace('Loading Phase 15 ', 'Loading ')
        $t = $t.Replace('Phase 15 ', '')

        foreach ($d in $DemoRenames) { if ($d.File -eq $pg.File) { $t = $t.Replace($d.Old, $d.New) } }

        Save-Text $f $t
        Write-Host ('  de-phased: Advisory\' + $pg.File) -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    # Edge + Historian: kicker removal + demo defaults cleared
    foreach ($pair in @(@($EdgePage, 'Register and monitor OT-safe collectors. Data flows one way, out of the plant network.'),
                        @($HistPage, 'Register a read-only OPC-UA or historian gateway, browse its tags, and map them into canonical form.'))) {
        $f = $pair[0]; $sub = $pair[1]
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
        $t = $CommentRegex.Replace($t, '//')
        $t = $KickerRegex.Replace($t, ('${1}' + $sub), 1)
        Save-Text $f $t
    }
    $edgeText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($EdgePage)
    $edgeText = $edgeText.Replace('useState("edge-demo-collector-01")', 'useState("")')
    $edgeText = $edgeText.Replace('useState("Demo OT-safe Edge Collector 01")', 'useState("")')
    Save-Text $EdgePage $edgeText
    $histText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($HistPage)
    $histText = $histText.Replace('useState("opc.tcp://demo-historian-gateway:4840")', 'useState("")')
    $histText = $histText.Replace('useState("urn:plantprocessiq:demo:historian")', 'useState("")')
    Save-Text $HistPage $histText
    Write-Host '  de-phased: EdgeCollectorPage + HistorianConnectorPage (kickers, demo defaults cleared)' -ForegroundColor Green

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # App.tsx import paths
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $app = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($AppTsx)
    $app = $app.Replace('./pages/Phase15/', './pages/Advisory/')
    Save-Text $AppTsx $app
    Write-Host '  patched: App.tsx (6 lazy import paths)' -ForegroundColor Green

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # POST-TRANSFORM SELF-CHECK: the pack must catch its own misses before the
    # vitest gate does. Any surviving Pack/T-id or phase token is a hard failure.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $residual = @()
    $checkFiles = @()
    Get-ChildItem $AdvisoryDir -File -Filter *.tsx | ForEach-Object { $checkFiles += $_.FullName }
    $checkFiles += $EdgePage; $checkFiles += $HistPage
    $PackRegex  = [regex]::new('Pack\s+[A-G][^\r\n]*T-\d+')
    $PhaseRegex = [regex]::new('phase\s*\d+', [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::IgnoreCase)
    foreach ($cf in $checkFiles) {
        $ct = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($cf)
        $name = Split-Path -Leaf $cf
        foreach ($m in $PackRegex.Matches($ct))  { $residual += ($name + ' :: ' + $m.Value) }
        foreach ($m in $PhaseRegex.Matches($ct)) { $residual += ($name + ' :: ' + $m.Value) }
    }
    if ($residual.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host 'SELF-CHECK FAILED - residual phase/pack tokens after transform:' -ForegroundColor Red
        foreach ($r in ($residual | Select-Object -Unique)) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $r) -ForegroundColor Red }
        throw 'residual tokens'
    }
    Write-Host '  self-check: 0 residual phase/pack tokens in the 8 pages' -ForegroundColor Green
}

    Write-Host ('FAILED: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

$gate = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($GatePath)
if (-not $gate.Contains('PAGE CONTENT')) {
    $append = @'

// ============================================================

describe("Step 2: the 8 customer-facing pages carry no phase or pack tokens", () => {

    Save-Text $GatePath ($gate.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + (($append -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n"))

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Step3a-PageHeaderAndStatGrid.ps1
# STEP 3a of the 8-page professionalisation plan. Prereqs: Step 1 + Step 2 done.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE BUG BEING FIXED
#   Every one of the 8 pages renders its key figures like this:
#
#       <section>
#         {summaryCards.map((card) => (
#           <div key={card.label}>
#             <span>{card.label}</span>
#             <strong>{card.value}</strong>
#           </div>
#         ))}
#       </section>
#
#   Bare <div>/<span>/<strong>. No class. No style. The pages declare cardStyle
#   and buttonStyle consts and APPLY THEM ZERO TIMES. That is why the browser
#   shows "Modeprivacy-preserving-cross-plant-industry-benchmarking" and
#   "Median107" - the label and value have no separation because there is no
#   layout at all. It is not a spacing bug; the UI was never built.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS PACK BUILDS (new, not re-exports - the noThinReExports gate applies)
#
#   src\components\standard\StandardPageHeader.tsx
#       title / subtitle / description / status (+ tone) / actions
#       Correct semantic order: TITLE first, then subtitle. Step 2 left the
#       subtitle rendering ABOVE the <h1> because it replaced the kicker line
#       in place. This fixes that.
#
#   src\components\standard\StandardStatGrid.tsx
#       items: { label, value, tone?, hint?, emphasis? }[]
#       Responsive grid of stat cards. Label above value, real spacing, tabular
#       numerals, tone colouring, and an "emphasis" flag to promote the ONE
#       number an operator acts on.
#       Accepts the existing { label, value } arrays unchanged.
#
#   Appends to src\components\standard\standard-components.css using the SAME
#   custom properties as the existing cards (--ppiq-std-border-subtle,
#   --ppiq-std-surface-1, --ppiq-std-text-soft, ...). No new colour invented.
#
#   Exports both from src\components\standard\index.ts
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS PACK CHANGES ON THE 8 PAGES
#   1. The header <section> -> <StandardPageHeader ... />
#      Descriptions are replaced with the approved copy from
#      PPIQ_8Page_Copy_Draft_09Jul2026.md. Compliance sentences are untouched -
#      they live further down each page, not in the header.
#   2. The stat <section>  -> <StandardStatGrid items={...} />
#      Handles both array names in use: summaryCards (7 pages) and statusCards
#      (HistorianConnectorPage).
#   3. Drops the leading `{ label: "Mode", value: ... }` card from every array.
#      "Mode" shows an internal engine identifier
#      ("privacy-preserving-cross-plant-industry-benchmarking"). It is the first
#      thing a CEO reads today and it means nothing to anyone.
#   4. Promotes the single most decision-relevant stat per page via emphasis.
#
#   RecommendationsPage keeps its extra {decisionMessage} node (captured, not
#   discarded). HistorianConnectorPage's `statusCards` name is preserved.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOT IN THIS PACK - lands in Step 3b (told to you up front, not discovered later)
#   * "Reload demo request" -> "Load sample request" + a Sample-data badge
#     (Value Realisation, Recommendations)
#   * demo-approver -> the logged-in user via useAuth()
#   * removing the /license route + Phase10LicenseDemoPage (Golden Rule)
#   * rewording /access-matrix "Role matrix for demo and buyer review."
#   These are behaviour/routing changes; this pack is presentation only, so a
#   failure here cannot break a page's data path.
#
# PREFLIGHT: every page's header block, stat block and Mode card are located
# BEFORE anything is written. One miss aborts with zero changes.
# Backed up, tsc + full architecture suite gated, auto-revert on failure.
#
# RUN: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Step3a-PageHeaderAndStatGrid.ps1
# ============================================================================

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\step3a-ui-" + $Stamp)

$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$HeaderComp = Join-Path $StdDir 'StandardPageHeader.tsx'
$StatComp   = Join-Path $StdDir 'StandardStatGrid.tsx'
$StdCss     = Join-Path $StdDir 'standard-components.css'
$StdIndex   = Join-Path $StdDir 'index.ts'

if (Test-Path $HeaderComp) { Write-Host 'FATAL: StandardPageHeader.tsx already exists.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }
if (Test-Path $StatComp)   { Write-Host 'FATAL: StandardStatGrid.tsx already exists.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

$Pages = @(
    @{ Rel='pages\Advisory\HonestyCertificationPage.tsx'; Emph='Status';
       Desc='Before any recommendation reaches an engineer, it is tested against a fixed set of honesty rules. This page runs those tests on demand and shows exactly which passed and which failed. A failed certification blocks the recommendation; it does not annotate it.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Advisory\BenchmarkingPage.tsx'; Emph='Plant percentile';

       Desc='When a recommendation is implemented, this page compares a frozen baseline KPI window against the actual window that followed. Attribution caveats remain visible: a measured improvement is not proof that the recommendation caused it.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Advisory\RecommendationsPage.tsx'; Emph='Recommendations';
       Desc='Recommendations are generated only from scenarios the evidence supports. Each carries an expected impact range, its supporting evidence, and its provenance. Nothing is applied to the plant: approval is explicit, and PlantProcess IQ never writes back to process control.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Advisory\ScenarioSimulationPage.tsx'; Emph='Support';
       Desc='Propose a change to a process parameter and see the projected effect. The engine refuses to project outside the envelope actually observed in your plant data, and it never writes a value back to the process.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\EdgeCollector\EdgeCollectorPage.tsx'; Emph='Queue depth';

$RxOpts     = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::None
$HeaderRx   = [regex]::new('<section>\s*<p>\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*</p>\s*<h1>([^<]*)</h1>\s*<p>\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*</p>\s*<strong>\{status\}</strong>([\s\S]*?)</section>', $RxOpts)
$StatRx     = [regex]::new('<section>\s*\{(\w+)\.map\(\(card\) => \(\s*<div key=\{card\.label\}>\s*<span>\{card\.label\}</span>\s*<strong>\{card\.value\}</strong>\s*</div>\s*\)\)\}\s*</section>', $RxOpts)

    if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { $missing += ('missing ' + $pg.Rel); continue }
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)
    if (-not $HeaderRx.IsMatch($t)) { $missing += ($pg.Rel + ' :: header <section> block') }
    if (-not $StatRx.IsMatch($t))   { $missing += ($pg.Rel + ' :: stat <section> block') }
    if (-not $ModeRx.IsMatch($t))   { $missing += ($pg.Rel + ' :: Mode card line') }
}
foreach ($f in @($StdCss, $StdIndex)) { if (-not (Test-Path $f)) { $missing += ('missing ' + $f) } }

if ($missing.Count -gt 0) {
    Write-Host 'PREFLIGHT FAILED - nothing changed:' -ForegroundColor Red
    foreach ($m in $missing) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $m) -ForegroundColor Red }
    exit 1
}

$BackupList = @()
function Backup-File {
    param([string]$Full)
    $rel = $Full.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)
    Copy-Item $Full (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    $script:BackupList += $rel
}

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $BackupList) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak (Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel) -Force }
    }
    foreach ($c in @($HeaderComp, $StatComp)) { if (Test-Path $c) { Remove-Item $c -Force } }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
function Save-Text { param([string]$Path, [string]$Text) [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $Utf8NoBom) }

$HeaderSrc = @'
// ============================================================
// FILE: src/components/standard/StandardPageHeader.tsx
// One page header for every full-page surface: title, subtitle, description,
// live status line and optional actions.
//
// Why this exists rather than reusing StandardCard: a page header is not a
// card. It carries the h1 (exactly one per page), an aria-live status region,
// and it must not draw a card border around the top of every screen.
// ============================================================
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import "./standard-components.css";

export type StandardPageHeaderTone = "neutral" | "good" | "warn" | "bad";

export type StandardPageHeaderProps = {
  title: ReactNode;
  subtitle?: ReactNode;
  description?: ReactNode;
  status?: ReactNode;
  statusTone?: StandardPageHeaderTone;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  children?: ReactNode;
};

export function StandardPageHeader({
  title,
  subtitle,
  description,
  status,
  statusTone = "neutral",
  actions,
  children,
}: StandardPageHeaderProps) {
  return (
    <header className="ppiq-std-page-header">
      <div className="ppiq-std-page-header__row">
        <div className="ppiq-std-page-header__titles">
          <h1 className="ppiq-std-page-header__title">{title}</h1>
          {subtitle ? <p className="ppiq-std-page-header__subtitle">{subtitle}</p> : null}
        </div>
        {actions ? <div className="ppiq-std-page-header__actions">{actions}</div> : null}
      </div>

      {description ? <p className="ppiq-std-page-header__description">{description}</p> : null}

      {status ? (
        <p
          className={"ppiq-std-page-header__status ppiq-std-page-header__status--" + statusTone}
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
        >
          {status}
        </p>
      ) : null}

      {children}
    </header>
  );
}
'@

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. StandardStatGrid.tsx
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$StatSrc = @'
// ============================================================
// FILE: src/components/standard/StandardStatGrid.tsx
// A grid of labelled figures.
//
// Replaces the hand-rolled `<div><span>{label}</span><strong>{value}</strong></div>`
// that shipped on eight pages with no class and no style, which is why the HMI
// rendered "Median107" and "Modeprivacy-preserving-...".
//
// - label sits ABOVE the value, never beside it, so they can never collide
// - values use tabular numerals so columns of figures line up
// - `emphasis` promotes the one figure the operator acts on
// - `tone` colours a value without inventing new colours (tokens only)
// ============================================================
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import "./standard-components.css";

export type StandardStatTone = "neutral" | "good" | "warn" | "bad";

export type StandardStatItem = {
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
  hint?: string;
  tone?: StandardStatTone;
  emphasis?: boolean;
};

export type StandardStatGridProps = {
  items: ReadonlyArray<StandardStatItem>;
  /**
   * Label of the single item to promote. Matched case-insensitively as a PREFIX,
   * so `emphasize="Realized"` also promotes a label rendered as "Realized EUR"
   * or "Realized \u20AC". Exact matching broke on currency-suffixed labels.
   */
  emphasize?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
};

export function StandardStatGrid({ items, emphasize, ariaLabel }: StandardStatGridProps) {
  if (!items || items.length === 0) return null;

  const key = emphasize ? emphasize.trim().toLowerCase() : null;

  return (
    <dl className="ppiq-std-stat-grid" aria-label={ariaLabel ?? "Key figures"}>
      {items.map((item) => {
        const promoted =
          item.emphasis === true ||
          (key !== null && item.label.trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(key));
        const tone = item.tone ?? "neutral";
        const cls =
          "ppiq-std-stat" +
          (promoted ? " ppiq-std-stat--emphasis" : "") +
          " ppiq-std-stat--" + tone;

        return (
          <div className={cls} key={item.label}>
            <dt className="ppiq-std-stat__label">{item.label}</dt>
            <dd className="ppiq-std-stat__value">{item.value}</dd>
            {item.hint ? <p className="ppiq-std-stat__hint">{item.hint}</p> : null}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </dl>
  );
}
'@

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CSS - same custom properties as the existing cards, no new colours
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CssSrc = @'

   Uses the existing --ppiq-std-* custom properties only.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Write components
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Norm { param([string]$s) return (($s -replace "`r`n", "`n") -replace "`n", "`r`n") }

try {
    Save-Text $HeaderComp (Norm $HeaderSrc)
    Save-Text $StatComp   (Norm $StatSrc)
    Write-Host '  created: StandardPageHeader.tsx, StandardStatGrid.tsx' -ForegroundColor Green

    $css = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($StdCss)
    if (-not $css.Contains('ppiq-std-stat-grid')) {
        Save-Text $StdCss ($css.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + (Norm $CssSrc) + "`r`n")
        Write-Host '  appended: standard-components.css (page header + stat grid)' -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    $idx = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($StdIndex)
    if (-not $idx.Contains('StandardPageHeader')) {
        $idx = $idx.TrimEnd() + "`r`n" + 'export * from "./StandardPageHeader";' + "`r`n" + 'export * from "./StandardStatGrid";' + "`r`n"
        Save-Text $StdIndex $idx
        Write-Host '  exported: both components from components/standard/index.ts' -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rewrite the 8 pages
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    foreach ($pg in $Pages) {
        $f = Join-Path $SrcRoot $pg.Rel
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($f)

        # -- header block --
        $hm = $HeaderRx.Match($t)
        $subtitle = $hm.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
        $title    = $hm.Groups[2].Value.Trim()
        $extra    = $hm.Groups[4].Value.Trim()   # e.g. the {decisionMessage} node

        $desc = $pg.Desc
        $hdrJsx = '<StandardPageHeader' + "`r`n" +
                  '        title="' + $title + '"' + "`r`n" +
                  '        subtitle="' + $subtitle + '"' + "`r`n" +
                  '        description="' + $desc + '"' + "`r`n" +
                  '        status={status}' + "`r`n" +
                  '      />'
        if ($extra.Length -gt 0) {
            $hdrJsx = $hdrJsx + "`r`n" + '      ' + $extra
        }
        $t = $HeaderRx.Replace($t, $hdrJsx, 1)

        # -- stat block --
        $sm = $StatRx.Match($t)
        $arr = $sm.Groups[1].Value
        $statJsx = '<StandardStatGrid items={' + $arr + '} emphasize="' + $pg.Emph + '" />'
        $t = $StatRx.Replace($t, $statJsx, 1)

        # -- drop the Mode card --
        $t = $ModeRx.Replace($t, '', 1)

        # -- import both components --
        if (-not $t.Contains('<StandardPageHeader')) { throw ('header JSX not injected in ' + $pg.Rel) }
        # Every one of the 8 pages already imports StandardButton from the barrel,
        # so MERGE the two new names into that existing import rather than adding a
        # second import of the same module (duplicate-import smell, and the naive
        # "insert after the last ^import line" approach spliced text inside the
        # braces of multi-line imports - that is what produced 39 tsc errors).
        # GUARD ON THE IMPORT, NOT ON THE FILE.
        # A previous version tested `-not $t.Contains('StandardStatGrid')`, but the
        # JSX <StandardStatGrid .../> has ALREADY been injected above, so the guard
        # was always false, the merge was skipped, and every page referenced two
        # components it never imported (16 x TS2304).
        $barrelRx = [regex]::new('import\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*"@/components/standard";')
        $bm = $barrelRx.Match($t)
        if (-not $bm.Success) { throw ('no "@/components/standard" import to merge into: ' + $pg.Rel) }
        $names = $bm.Groups[1].Value.Trim()
        if ($names -notmatch 'StandardStatGrid') {
            $merged = 'import { ' + $names + ', StandardPageHeader, StandardStatGrid } from "@/components/standard";'
            $t = $t.Remove($bm.Index, $bm.Length).Insert($bm.Index, $merged)
        }

        Save-Text $f $t
        Write-Host ('  rebuilt: ' + $pg.Rel + '  (emphasis: ' + $pg.Emph + ')') -ForegroundColor Green
    }

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Self-check: no raw label/value div may survive on the 8 pages
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $residual = @()
    foreach ($pg in $Pages) {
        $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $SrcRoot $pg.Rel))
        if ($t -match '<span>\{card\.label\}</span>')     { $residual += ($pg.Rel + ' :: raw label/value div') }
        if ($t -match '\{\s*label:\s*"Mode"')             { $residual += ($pg.Rel + ' :: Mode card survived') }
        if (-not $t.Contains('StandardStatGrid items='))  { $residual += ($pg.Rel + ' :: stat grid not injected') }
        if (-not $t.Contains('<StandardPageHeader'))      { $residual += ($pg.Rel + ' :: page header not injected') }
        # the import must actually name both components, or tsc will fail with TS2304
        if ($t -notmatch 'import\s*\{[^}]*StandardPageHeader[^}]*StandardStatGrid[^}]*\}\s*from\s*"@/components/standard";') {
            $residual += ($pg.Rel + ' :: components used but NOT imported')
        }
    }
    if ($residual.Count -gt 0) {
        Write-Host 'SELF-CHECK FAILED:' -ForegroundColor Red
        foreach ($r in $residual) { Write-Host ('  - ' + $r) -ForegroundColor Red }
        throw 'self-check'
    }
    Write-Host '  self-check: 0 raw stat divs, 0 Mode cards, 8/8 grids injected' -ForegroundColor Green
}
catch {
    Write-Host ('FAILED: ' + $_.Exception.Message) -ForegroundColor Red
    Restore-All; exit 1
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gates
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (-not $SkipFrontend) {
    Write-Host '=== Build gate: tsc -b ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $WebRoot
    & cmd /c "npx tsc -b"
    $tscExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($tscExit -ne 0) { Write-Host 'tsc FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'tsc GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green

    Write-Host '=== FULL architecture suite ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Push-Location $WebRoot
    & cmd /c "npx vitest run src/test/architecture/"
    $g = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
    if ($g -ne 0) { Write-Host 'GATES FAILED - reverting.' -ForegroundColor Red; Restore-All; exit 1 }
    Write-Host 'Architecture gates GREEN.' -ForegroundColor Green
}
else { Write-Host 'SkipFrontend set.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '=== STEP 3a COMPLETE ===' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host ('Backups: ' + $BackupDir)
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'RENDER CHECK - this is the whole point of the pack:'
Write-Host '  /advisory/benchmarking  -> "Median" and "107" on SEPARATE lines;'
Write-Host '                             "Plant percentile" is the big cyan number;'
Write-Host '                             no "Mode" card at all'
Write-Host '  /advisory/roi-cfo-dashboard -> "Realized value" promoted'
Write-Host '  /edge-collector             -> "Queue depth" promoted'
Write-Host '  Every page: title first, subtitle under it, description, status line.'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'COMMIT:'
Write-Host '  git add Frontend/PlantProcess.Web/src'
Write-Host '  git commit -m "Step 3a: add StandardPageHeader + StandardStatGrid; rebuild the 8 customer-facing page headers and stat grids; drop the internal Mode card"'
Write-Host ''
Write-Host 'NEXT: Step 3b - sample-data badges, demo-approver -> logged-in user,'
Write-Host '      remove the /license route, reword /access-matrix.'
exit 0

# ============================================================================
# Apply-Step3b-HonestyAndCleanup.ps1
# STEP 3b - the behaviour and routing half of Step 3. Prereqs: Steps 1, 2, 3a.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A. TRUTHFUL SAMPLE DATA  (Recommendations, Value Realisation)
#
#    Both pages call advisoryApi.recommendationDemoRequest() /
#    valueRealizationDemoRequest(). These FETCH THE PAGE'S ONLY DATA - deleting
#    the button leaves a blank page. So they are not removed; they are told the
#    truth about what they are:
#
#      "Reload demo request"            -> "Load sample request"
#      "Loading demo request..."        -> "Loading sample request..."
#      + a visible "Sample data - not from your plant" badge under the header
#
#    Replacing a canned request with a real pending one is a BACKEND change and
#    is deliberately out of scope. The badge makes the current state honest.
#
#    Also on Recommendations:
#      "Demo request uses the Pack G-3 deterministic scenario engine." -> reworded.
#      (The existing gate missed this: "Pack G-3" carries no T-nnn.)
#      "Dismissed from demo workspace." -> "Recommendation dismissed."
#
# B. REAL APPROVER IDENTITY  (Recommendations)  -- the one non-cosmetic fix
#
#      approverUserId: "demo-approver"   ->   approverUserId: user?.userName ?? "unknown"
#
#    An approval audit trail that records a fabricated approver is a compliance
#    defect, not a naming problem. useAuth() is wired into the component.
#
# C. /license ROUTE REMOVED  (Golden Rule)
#
#    /license renders Phase10LicenseDemoPage - "Phase 10 License Runtime Demo",
#    a DEMO of a feature that ALREADY SHIPS PROPERLY at /commercial/license
#    (CommercialLicensePage). It is a duplicate demo inside the product.
#    Removed: the canonical route, the two redirects M1-08 added
#    (/phase10/license, /license-demo), the lazy import, and the page file.
#    /commercial/license and /commercial-license are UNTOUCHED.
#
#    The M1-08 gate asserts the /phase10/license redirect exists. A gate cannot
#    outlive the route it guards, so that assertion is removed in the same pack.
#
# D. KICKER ERADICATION ON THE REMAINING REACHABLE PAGES
#
#    M1-08 cleaned routes and nav labels but left task kickers inside page
#    BODIES. Five reachable pages still display them, three of them from the
#    sidebar:
#      Suggestions            P08 . T-045 . Suggestion & Recommendation page
#      Assistant              P08 . T-046 . Assistant chat with grounding runtime
#      Assistant Configuration P08 . T-047 . Configure assistant from HMI
#      Persona Access Matrix  P09 . T-051/T-053 . Formal RBAC and route visibility
#      Executive Dashboard    P09 . T-052 . Executive / CEO persona scope
#    Each kicker becomes a plain-language subtitle.
#
# E. THE GATE GOES REPO-WIDE
#
#    Until now the page-content gate covered only the 8 advisory pages, because
#    /license and /access-matrix had not been ruled on. Both are settled here, so
#    the gate now scans EVERY src/pages/**/*.tsx for:
#      - "Pack <A-G>" or "P<nn>" followed by a T-id   (catches "Pack G-3" too)
#      - <h1> containing "Phase <n>"
#      - data-testid containing a phase token
#      - any route path "/license" rendering a demo page
#
# PREFLIGHT verifies every anchor first. One miss = zero changes.
# Backed up, tsc + full architecture suite gated, auto-revert on failure.
# RUN: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\Apply-Step3b-HonestyAndCleanup.ps1
# ============================================================================

[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$SkipFrontend)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0

$RepoRoot = (Get-Location).Path
$WebRoot  = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'Frontend\PlantProcess.Web'
$SrcRoot  = Join-Path $WebRoot 'src'
if (-not (Test-Path $SrcRoot)) { Write-Host 'FATAL: run from the repo root.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }

$Stamp     = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$BackupDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot ("deploy\.ppiq-backups\step3b-" + $Stamp)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $BackupDir -Force | Out-Null
$Utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)

$AppTsx   = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'App.tsx'
$RecPage  = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'pages\Advisory\RecommendationsPage.tsx'
$ValPage  = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'pages\Advisory\ValueRealizationPage.tsx'
$StdCss   = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'components\standard\standard-components.css'
$GatePath = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'test\architecture\noPhaseTokensOnDemoPath.test.ts'
$LicPage  = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'pages\Phase10\Phase10LicenseDemoPage.tsx'
$LicDir   = Join-Path $SrcRoot 'pages\Phase10'

# Kicker pages: relative path -> replacement subtitle
$KickerPages = @(
    @{ Rel='pages\Phase8\SuggestionRecommendationPage.tsx';  Sub='Guarded recommendations generated only from scenarios the evidence supports.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Phase8\AssistantRuntimePage.tsx';          Sub='Ask questions about your plant data and receive answers with cited evidence.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Phase8\AssistantConfigurationPage.tsx';    Sub='Grounding, evidence and egress controls for the assistant.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Phase9\PersonaAccessMatrixPage.tsx';       Sub='Role and permission matrix by persona.' }
    @{ Rel='pages\Phase9\ExecutivePersonaDashboardPage.tsx'; Sub='Executive view of plant performance and realised value.' }
)

# Matches "P08 . T-045 . ..." and "Pack G . T-101 . ..." without needing the
# non-ASCII middot literal in this file.
#
# NOT line-anchored. The advisory pages put the kicker on its own line, but these
# pages inline it inside the tag:
#     <p className="phase9-eyebrow">P09 . T-051/T-053 . Formal RBAC ...</p>
# An anchored '^[ \t]*P09' never matches that, which is exactly what preflight
# caught. `[^<\r\n]*` keeps the match inside a single text node.
$KickerRx = [regex]::new('(?:Pack\s+[A-G]|P\d{2})\s[^<\r\n]*?T-\d+[^<\r\n]*')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PREFLIGHT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write-Host '=== STEP 3b preflight ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan
$missing = @()

foreach ($p in @($AppTsx, $RecPage, $ValPage, $StdCss, $GatePath)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $p)) { $missing += ('missing ' + $p) }
}

$rec = if (Test-Path $RecPage) { [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($RecPage) } else { '' }
$val = if (Test-Path $ValPage) { [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($ValPage) } else { '' }
$app = if (Test-Path $AppTsx)  { [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($AppTsx)  } else { '' }
$gate= if (Test-Path $GatePath){ [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($GatePath) } else { '' }

$recAnchors = @(

    'Demo request uses the Pack G-3 deterministic scenario engine.',
    'export function RecommendationsPage() {',
    '<StandardPageHeader'

foreach ($a in $recAnchors) { if (-not $rec.Contains($a)) { $missing += ('RecommendationsPage :: ' + $a) } }

$valAnchors = @('>Reload demo request</StandardButton>', '<p>Loading demo request...</p>', '<StandardPageHeader')
foreach ($a in $valAnchors) { if (-not $val.Contains($a)) { $missing += ('ValueRealizationPage :: ' + $a) } }

$appAnchors = @(

    '<Route path="/license-demo" element={<Navigate to="/license" replace />} />',

foreach ($a in $appAnchors) { if (-not $app.Contains($a)) { $missing += ('App.tsx :: ' + $a) } }

    exit 1
}
Write-Host 'All anchors present.' -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BACKUP
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$BackupList = @()
function Backup-File {
    param([string]$Full)
    $rel = $Full.Substring($RepoRoot.Length + 1)
    Copy-Item $Full (Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')) -Force
    $script:BackupList += $rel
}
foreach ($p in @($AppTsx, $RecPage, $ValPage, $StdCss, $GatePath, $LicPage)) { Backup-File $p }
foreach ($kp in $KickerPages) { Backup-File (Join-Path $SrcRoot $kp.Rel) }

function Restore-All {
    Write-Host 'REVERTING...' -ForegroundColor Yellow
    foreach ($rel in $BackupList) {
        $bak = Join-Path $BackupDir ($rel -replace '[\\/:]', '__')
        $dst = Join-Path $RepoRoot $rel
        $dir = Split-Path -Parent $dst
        if (-not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
        if (Test-Path $bak) { Copy-Item $bak $dst -Force }
    }
    Write-Host ('Reverted. Backups in ' + $BackupDir) -ForegroundColor Yellow
}
function Save-Text { param([string]$Path, [string]$Text) [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $Text, $Utf8NoBom) }

$SampleBadge = '<p className="ppiq-std-sample-badge">Sample data - not from your plant</p>'

try {
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A + B. RecommendationsPage
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $t = $rec
    $t = $t.Replace('>Reload demo request</StandardButton>', '>Load sample request</StandardButton>')
    $t = $t.Replace('"Dismissed from demo workspace."', '"Recommendation dismissed."')
    $t = $t.Replace('Demo request uses the Pack G-3 deterministic scenario engine.',
                    'This is a sample request evaluated by the deterministic scenario engine.')
    $t = $t.Replace('approverUserId: "demo-approver",', 'approverUserId: user?.userName ?? "unknown",')

    # useAuth import + hook
    if (-not $t.Contains('@/state/AuthContext')) {
        $barrel = 'import { StandardButton, StandardPageHeader, StandardStatGrid } from "@/components/standard";'
        if (-not $t.Contains($barrel)) { throw 'RecommendationsPage: standard barrel import not found (did Step 3a run?)' }
        $t = $t.Replace($barrel, $barrel + "`r`n" + 'import { useAuth } from "@/state/AuthContext";')
    }
    if (-not $t.Contains('const { user } = useAuth();')) {
        $sig = 'export function RecommendationsPage() {'
        $t = $t.Replace($sig, $sig + "`r`n" + '  const { user } = useAuth();')
    }

    # sample badge after the page header element
    $hdrEnd = [regex]::new('(<StandardPageHeader[\s\S]*?/>)')
    $t = $hdrEnd.Replace($t, ('$1' + "`r`n      " + $SampleBadge), 1)

    Save-Text $RecPage $t
    Write-Host '  RecommendationsPage: sample labelling, real approver identity, honest wording' -ForegroundColor Green

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A. ValueRealizationPage
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    $t = $val

// ============================================================
// STEP 3b - REPO-WIDE page-content gate.

import { readdirSync, statSync } from "node:fs";

function allPageFiles(dir: string, out: string[] = []): string[] {
